Title: James Tait Black Prizes
Subtitle: 100 Years of Great Writing
Teaser: The UK’s longest-running literary prizes are awarded at this special centenary event as Sally Magnusson hosts a celebration of the best works of fiction and biography. Shortlisted authors include Will Eaves, Jessie Greengrass, Olivia Laing, Nafissa...
Description: The UK’s longest-running literary prizes are awarded at this special centenary event as Sally Magnusson hosts a celebration of the best works of fiction and biography. Shortlisted authors include Will Eaves, Jessie Greengrass, Olivia Laing, Nafissa Thompson-Spires, Lindsey Hilsum, Susannah Walker and Edward Wilson-Lee. The authors take to the stage to discuss their books and a new creative writing prize will be presented to mark the 100th anniversary of the annual prizes awarded by the University of Edinburgh. In association with the University of Edinburgh.

Title: Sue Prideaux
Subtitle: European Icon Reassessed
Teaser: German philosopher Friedrich Nietzsche has been a totemic figure for the left and right, but what if his ideas have been wildly misunderstood by both? Award-winning biographer of Edvard Munch and August Strindberg, Sue Prideaux tackles another European...
Description: German philosopher Friedrich Nietzsche has been a totemic figure for the left and right, but what if his ideas have been wildly misunderstood by both? Award-winning biographer of Edvard Munch and August Strindberg, Sue Prideaux tackles another European figure of huge significance in the excellently-titled I am Dynamite! A Life of Friedrich Nietzsche. Today she looks beyond the legends to get at the real man, in a conversation with Stuart Kelly.

Title: Janette Ayachi, Liz Berry, Toria Garbutt & Clare Pollard
Subtitle: Motherhood: Four Poets
Teaser: A new wave of acclaimed and award-winning contemporary poets who write about motherhood come together to present their latest work. Through four captivating readings, Janette Ayachi, Liz Berry, Toria Garbutt and Clare Pollard bring their bold, resonant...
Description: A new wave of acclaimed and award-winning contemporary poets who write about motherhood come together to present their latest work. Through four captivating readings, Janette Ayachi, Liz Berry, Toria Garbutt and Clare Pollard bring their bold, resonant and unique voices to the often unarticulated nuances of maternity in all its forms: tender, anguished, joyful.

Title: Inua Ellams & Kei Miller
Subtitle: Prize-winning narrative verse
Teaser: From rural Nigeria to Mount Olympus, Inua Ellams’s verse novel The Half God of Rainfall interweaves ancient and urban myths to tell a story of pride, power and revenge. Forward Prize-winner Kei Miller explores legends, histories and landscapes on the...
Description: From rural Nigeria to Mount Olympus, Inua Ellams’s verse novel The Half God of Rainfall interweaves ancient and urban myths to tell a story of pride, power and revenge. Forward Prize-winner Kei Miller explores legends, histories and landscapes on the fringes of Jamaican society in his collection In Nearby Bushes. Join them for a celebration of the emotive powers of narrative verse.

Title: Release Your Inner Poet: Spoken Word Workshop
Teaser: From #Instapoetry to TV ads, poetry and spoken word are gaining popularity every day. Do you have an inner wordsmith waiting to be heard? Have you dreamed of taking to the stage with your thoughts and poems? Two of the UK’s top poetry stars – Liz...
Description: From #Instapoetry to TV ads, poetry and spoken word are gaining popularity every day. Do you have an inner wordsmith waiting to be heard? Have you dreamed of taking to the stage with your thoughts and poems? Two of the UK’s top poetry stars – Liz Berry and Toria Garbutt – host an energetic workshop giving you the tools to write and perform like a pro.

Title: Beerjacket
Subtitle: Bookshelf Blues
Teaser: Glasgow alt-folk musician Beerjacket (aka Peter Kelly) has played with some of the biggest names in music, from Frightened Rabbit to The National, thanks to his rich songwriting style. With new album-book combination Silver Cords, he has paired each...
Description: Glasgow alt-folk musician Beerjacket (aka Peter Kelly) has played with some of the biggest names in music, from Frightened Rabbit to The National, thanks to his rich songwriting style. With new album-book combination Silver Cords, he has paired each song with a story spun from the lyrics. They act as a bulwark against the impermanence of digital music and Beerjacket shares them with you in this event.

Title: Mark Haddon
Subtitle: A new classic
Teaser: Mark Haddon is back with his first novel in seven years – and this could be his masterwork. The author behind The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time takes us on another wildly imaginative adventure in The Porpoise, a modern-day reworking of...
Description: Mark Haddon is back with his first novel in seven years – and this could be his masterwork. The author behind The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time takes us on another wildly imaginative adventure in The Porpoise, a modern-day reworking of Shakespeare’s Pericles. Haddon discusses one of the must-read novels of the year with Guardian writer and classics expert Charlotte Higgins.

Title: Tom Devine
Subtitle: The Clearances and the Scottish people
Teaser: The Clearances of the 18th and 19th centuries helped shape the nation we know today, but historians have struggled to define what happened. Scotland’s leading historian, Sir Tom Devine, brings us The Scottish Clearances, his authoritative, readable...
Description: The Clearances of the 18th and 19th centuries helped shape the nation we know today, but historians have struggled to define what happened. Scotland’s leading historian, Sir Tom Devine, brings us The Scottish Clearances, his authoritative, readable and even-handed account. Today, he sets the record straight, conjuring the voices of the dispossessed and exploding myths about this defining period for Scotland and its people.

Title: Roger McGough
Subtitle: Bringing people together with poetry
Teaser: One of the country’s best-loved poets is back in Edinburgh with a brand new collection that is typically wry, warm and subtle. Roger McGough may have his Liverpool home deep in his core, but he has long proved to be a truly universal voice. This...
Description: One of the country’s best-loved poets is back in Edinburgh with a brand new collection that is typically wry, warm and subtle. Roger McGough may have his Liverpool home deep in his core, but he has long proved to be a truly universal voice. This evening he builds on a reputation forged over half a century with work that’s both playful and poignant.

Title: Jeanette Winterson
Subtitle: Modern monsters and mad genius
Teaser: What would Mary Shelley think of artificial intelligence? In her new novel Frankissstein, Jeanette Winterson collapses the centuries, contrasting Shelley’s creation with a modern world where technology, sex, politics and money converge in a...
Description: What would Mary Shelley think of artificial intelligence? In her new novel Frankissstein, Jeanette Winterson collapses the centuries, contrasting Shelley’s creation with a modern world where technology, sex, politics and money converge in a nightmarish future. Join Winterson for a rollicking queer feminist critique, rolled up in a hilarious love story where a young transgender doctor falls for a celebrated professor of AI.

Title: Murray Pittock
Subtitle: Enlightened Edinburgh
Teaser: Professor of English Literature at Glasgow University, Murray Pittock’s work focuses on Edinburgh and its civic development across the 17th and 18th centuries. Some of the main drivers of national cultural change, including newspapers, gentry politics...
Description: Professor of English Literature at Glasgow University, Murray Pittock’s work focuses on Edinburgh and its civic development across the 17th and 18th centuries. Some of the main drivers of national cultural change, including newspapers, gentry politics and coffee house culture, were based in the city but what was the real reason for Edinburgh’s Enlightenment? Find out as Pittock discusses his fascinating study with John Gordon.

Title: Raja Shehadeh
Subtitle: Ramallah in reflection
Teaser: Going Home: A Walk Through Fifty Years of Occupation is Raja Shehadeh’s absorbing account of a day-long walk through Ramallah, the Palestinian city of his birth, on the anniversary of its occupation. As he walks, he considers the political...
Description: Going Home: A Walk Through Fifty Years of Occupation is Raja Shehadeh’s absorbing account of a day-long walk through Ramallah, the Palestinian city of his birth, on the anniversary of its occupation. As he walks, he considers the political frustrations he has witnessed, the changes in the city and his memories of people and place. Shehadeh discusses this profoundly personal book with theatre director David Greig.

Title: Quintin Jardine
Subtitle: Cold cases hotting up
Teaser: Ex-Chief Constable Bob Skinner is enjoying his 30th anniversary as a fictional character and in book number 30, Cold Case, his Scottish creator Quintin Jardine turns the screw on him once again. When a journalist uncovers fresh evidence about a case...
Description: Ex-Chief Constable Bob Skinner is enjoying his 30th anniversary as a fictional character and in book number 30, Cold Case, his Scottish creator Quintin Jardine turns the screw on him once again. When a journalist uncovers fresh evidence about a case that has been closed for three decades, Skinner is dragged back to save an old pal. Hear from this prolific master about the creation of an epic series.

Title: Selva Almada & Polly Clark
Subtitle: Stories from the edge of the world
Teaser: The best novels conjure mental images that we’re unlikely to see in reality. Selva Almada’s debut The Wind That Lays Waste evokes the squat trees, sweat-stained shirts and broken-down cars of rural Argentina. Set on the other side of the world,...
Description: The best novels conjure mental images that we’re unlikely to see in reality. Selva Almada’s debut The Wind That Lays Waste evokes the squat trees, sweat-stained shirts and broken-down cars of rural Argentina. Set on the other side of the world, Polly Clark’s Tiger plunges us into the Siberian taiga to sample life in one of the last wildernesses. Today, they reveal the secrets to creating vivid imaginative journeys, in conversation with Jenny Brown.

Title: Sue Lawrence & Angela Meyer
Subtitle: Whipping up historical storms
Teaser: Masterchef winner Sue Lawrence is known for her cookery writing but is also an established writer of historical thrillers. Lawrence discusses Down to the Sea, a tense affair switching between modern-day and 1890s Edinburgh. Melbourne-based Angela...
Description: Masterchef winner Sue Lawrence is known for her cookery writing but is also an established writer of historical thrillers. Lawrence discusses Down to the Sea, a tense affair switching between modern-day and 1890s Edinburgh. Melbourne-based Angela Meyer’s debut A Superior Spectre also zips back and forth in time, and 1860s Edinburgh provides a dark setting. Hear how the city’s past sparked these authors' imaginations, as they talk to Jenny Brown.

Title: Erling Kagge
Subtitle: Slow Expeditions
Teaser: Norwegian explorer Erling Kagge was the first in history to reach the ‘three poles’ – North, South and the summit of Everest. He’s also the bestselling author of Silence. His latest book is Walking, an illuminating, quietly life-changing...
Description: Norwegian explorer Erling Kagge was the first in history to reach the ‘three poles’ – North, South and the summit of Everest. He’s also the bestselling author of Silence. His latest book is Walking, an illuminating, quietly life-changing celebration of putting one foot in front of the other. Kagge draws observations from his own life: walking in cities like Oslo and LA, his Polar expeditions and even his journey walking the New York sewer system. He discusses the joys of his travels with Gavin Francis.

Title: Sue Armstrong & Daniela Mari
Subtitle: Growing old gracefully
Teaser: With an ageing global population, the question of how to live long and well has never been more pertinent. In Borrowed Time, science writer Sue Armstrong harnesses the latest research to ask how and why we age. In Breakfast with the Centenarians,...
Description: With an ageing global population, the question of how to live long and well has never been more pertinent. In Borrowed Time, science writer Sue Armstrong harnesses the latest research to ask how and why we age. In Breakfast with the Centenarians, gerontology expert Daniela Mari turns to supercentenarians to learn the art of growing old. Together, they unpack the secrets to a long life, in converstaion with Sheena McDonald.

Title: Marianne Taylor
Subtitle: Where now for the wildcat?
Teaser: Writer, photographer and illustrator Marianne Taylor has had a lifelong passion for wildlife. But what is it about the Scottish wildcat that holds such fascination for her? As Britain’s rarest mammal and one of the most endangered carnivores in the...
Description: Writer, photographer and illustrator Marianne Taylor has had a lifelong passion for wildlife. But what is it about the Scottish wildcat that holds such fascination for her? As Britain’s rarest mammal and one of the most endangered carnivores in the world, wildcats have endured centuries of habitat loss; but is the end truly nigh? Find out in this informative conversation.

Title: Rachel Long, Tania Nwachukwu & Hibaq Osman
Subtitle: Octavia Poetry Collective
Teaser: Octavia is a poetry collective for women of colour founded by Rachel Long in response to the lack of representation in literature and academia. Since 2015, Octavia have read beyond the canon and written themselves on their own terms, coming together...
Description: Octavia is a poetry collective for women of colour founded by Rachel Long in response to the lack of representation in literature and academia. Since 2015, Octavia have read beyond the canon and written themselves on their own terms, coming together every month at the Southbank Centre. This event showcases the breathtaking talents of Rachel Long, Tania Nwachukwu and Hibaq Osman in an hour of unforgettable poetry.

Title: Ragnar Jónasson & Denzil Meyrick
Subtitle: Crime counts
Teaser: Set on the isolated Icelandic coast, Ragnar Jónasson’s The Island tells the story of two crimes a decade apart with curious links, and a killer who could be stalking the barren outpost. Glasgow-born Denzil Meyrick’s A Breath on Dying Embers is his...
Description: Set on the isolated Icelandic coast, Ragnar Jónasson’s The Island tells the story of two crimes a decade apart with curious links, and a killer who could be stalking the barren outpost. Glasgow-born Denzil Meyrick’s A Breath on Dying Embers is his latest DCI Daley thriller, which fans of police drama, startling twists and bleak humour will love. They discuss the building blocks of gripping crime writing.

Title: Katie Hale & Rita Indiana
Subtitle: After the apocalypse
Teaser: If you’re searching for original, ineffably readable fiction, look no further. Cumbria-born Katie Hale’s My Name is Monster is the story of a woman named Monster who washes up on a post-apocalyptic shore. From the Dominican Republic, musician and...
Description: If you’re searching for original, ineffably readable fiction, look no further. Cumbria-born Katie Hale’s My Name is Monster is the story of a woman named Monster who washes up on a post-apocalyptic shore. From the Dominican Republic, musician and writer Rita Indiana discusses Tentacle, her energetic novel plunging into questions about climate change, queer politics and Yoruba ritual. Two genre masters take you into their apocalyptic worlds in a discussion with fellow novelist Angela Meyer.

Title: Raymond Antrobus & Joe Dunthorne
Subtitle: Poetry in the raw
Teaser: Poems of identity and the experience of living with deafness populate The Perseverance, the Ted Hughes Award-winning debut collection from British Jamaican poet Raymond Antrobus. Meanwhile, following his hit novels Submarine and The Adulterants, Joe...
Description: Poems of identity and the experience of living with deafness populate The Perseverance, the Ted Hughes Award-winning debut collection from British Jamaican poet Raymond Antrobus. Meanwhile, following his hit novels Submarine and The Adulterants, Joe Dunthorne has made the leap from prose to verse in O Positive, a collection brimming with his trademark humour and strangeness. Two poets discuss their uniquely accomplished debuts.

Title: Agustín Fernández Mallo & Thomas Bunstead
Subtitle: Real life autofiction
Teaser: Agustín Fernández Mallo’s devilishly delightful Nocilla trilogy has redefined Spain’s literary landscape. It concludes with Nocilla Lab, which captures our digital age through the use of multiple narratives and styles, from memoir and horror to...
Description: Agustín Fernández Mallo’s devilishly delightful Nocilla trilogy has redefined Spain’s literary landscape. It concludes with Nocilla Lab, which captures our digital age through the use of multiple narratives and styles, from memoir and horror to graphic novel. In this event, Mallo is joined by his translator Thomas Bunstead for a conversation exploring this new fictional terrain and the conclusion to his trilogy, one of the most daring literary experiments of the 21st century.

Title: Julia Donaldson & Catherine Rayner: Performing Picture Books
Teaser: Multi award-winning author of The Gruffalo, Julia Donaldson has teamed up with hugely talented illustrator Catherine Rayner on The Go-Away Bird, a beautiful rhyming story about the power of friendship. They kick off this year's Festival with a lively...
Description: Multi award-winning author of The Gruffalo, Julia Donaldson has teamed up with hugely talented illustrator Catherine Rayner on The Go-Away Bird, a beautiful rhyming story about the power of friendship. They kick off this year's Festival with a lively performance full of singing, drawing and dancing, guaranteed to bring a smile to your face.

Title: Harry Hill: Stand Up Star
Teaser: Top comedian and entertainer Harry Hill returns to the Festival with his latest comic caper, Matt Millz Stands Up! Matt is finally a star, but he’s been so busy soaking up the showbiz life that he hasn’t written any new jokes. Can Matt save himself...
Description: Top comedian and entertainer Harry Hill returns to the Festival with his latest comic caper, Matt Millz Stands Up! Matt is finally a star, but he’s been so busy soaking up the showbiz life that he hasn’t written any new jokes. Can Matt save himself from the ultimate heckling humiliation? Find out as Harry tells the tale in an event packed full of heart and humour.

Title: Into the Wild with Julian Clary & David Roberts
Teaser: Get ready to monkey around with the Bolds, the wildest family in Teddington, trying to fit into a neighbourhood in which they don’t quite belong… Comedian and entertainer Julian Clary and illustrator David Roberts introduce the fifth book in their...
Description: Get ready to monkey around with the Bolds, the wildest family in Teddington, trying to fit into a neighbourhood in which they don’t quite belong… Comedian and entertainer Julian Clary and illustrator David Roberts introduce the fifth book in their bestselling series, The Bolds Go Wild. Expect fun and games, lots of readings and loads of live drawing in an event filled with animal hilarity.

Title: Kwame Alexander, Sarah Crossan & Jason Reynolds: Writing Rhythm
Teaser: Three authors for young adults come together for a lively conversation about verse novels, their growing popularity and how to tell diverse, dynamic stories. Kwame Alexander and Jason Reynolds are CILIP Carnegie Medal-shortlisted authors and Sarah...
Description: Three authors for young adults come together for a lively conversation about verse novels, their growing popularity and how to tell diverse, dynamic stories. Kwame Alexander and Jason Reynolds are CILIP Carnegie Medal-shortlisted authors and Sarah Crossan is the current Irish Children's Laureate. Their stories, with their flowing narrative rhythms inspired by sports, hip hop and other cultural influences, have successfully encouraged reluctant readers to get into books. Join three accomplished authors for this fascinating discussion. In association with CILIP Carnegie and Kate Greenaway Medals.

Title: A Library of Spellbooks with Scarlett Thomas & Piers Torday
Teaser: Scarlett Thomas is the author of the enchanting Worldquake series, which Joanne Harris called the ‘most exciting debut in children’s fiction since Harry Potter’. Piers Torday is the bestselling author of The Last Wild trilogy and winner of the...
Description: Scarlett Thomas is the author of the enchanting Worldquake series, which Joanne Harris called the ‘most exciting debut in children’s fiction since Harry Potter’. Piers Torday is the bestselling author of The Last Wild trilogy and winner of the Guardian Children’s Fiction Prize. Join a spellbinding discussion on the latest instalments in their captivating series covering talking animals, forbidden spells and two magical libraries.

Title: Improvising Stories with Vivian French & Petr Horáček
Teaser: Following the success of last year’s improvised event, favourite Festival storyteller Vivian French returns with illustrator Petr Horáček to craft a new story based on your ideas. Suggest exciting plot points to Vivian and guide Petr’s drawing...
Description: Following the success of last year’s improvised event, favourite Festival storyteller Vivian French returns with illustrator Petr Horáček to craft a new story based on your ideas. Suggest exciting plot points to Vivian and guide Petr’s drawing hand as they show what it takes to create imaginative stories like Oliver’s Vegetables and Puffin Peter.

Title: Jamie Littler & Danny Wallace: Monstrous Hilarity
Teaser: Comedian-turned-author Danny Wallace and illustrator Jamie Littler bring you the latest laugh-out-loud story of Hamish Ellerby. There's a plot afoot in Starkley, and it’s down to Hamish and his pals to save the world with the help of the top secret...
Description: Comedian-turned-author Danny Wallace and illustrator Jamie Littler bring you the latest laugh-out-loud story of Hamish Ellerby. There's a plot afoot in Starkley, and it’s down to Hamish and his pals to save the world with the help of the top secret Monster Patrol. See Hamish’s hilarious adventures come alive as Jamie draws live, while Danny talks about the story in his warm and witty style.

Title: The Rotsome Words of Roald Dahl
Teaser: Get ready to be goose-gruggled and fluckgungled with lively linguists Sara-Jane Arbury and Fiona Ross as they take a light-hearted look at some of the naughtiest words and phrases created by the infamously inventive children’s author, Roald Dahl....
Description: Get ready to be goose-gruggled and fluckgungled with lively linguists Sara-Jane Arbury and Fiona Ross as they take a light-hearted look at some of the naughtiest words and phrases created by the infamously inventive children’s author, Roald Dahl. Spend an anarchic hour discovering the most mischievously rude words in Roald's whizzpopping worlds and uncover some frobscottling facts.

Title: Vikings and Dragons with David MacPhail
Teaser: Venture with Vikings and author David MacPhail as he introduces the seventh book in his funny and fearsome series about Thorfinn, the world’s worst Viking! From across the world, Vikings are travelling to the Shetland Islands for the Great Fire...
Description: Venture with Vikings and author David MacPhail as he introduces the seventh book in his funny and fearsome series about Thorfinn, the world’s worst Viking! From across the world, Vikings are travelling to the Shetland Islands for the Great Fire Festival. Can Thorfinn steal the show by tracking down a legendary dragon? Join David for an hour of plundering, raiding and Viking fun.

Title: Making Connections with Brian Conaghan & Lisa Williamson
Teaser: Award-winning author of The Art of Being Normal, Lisa Williamson brings you a new tale about painfully shy Ro, who’s keeping secrets from her friends. In Brian Conaghan’s The M-Word, Maggie has taken so many hard knocks she’s earned the nickname...
Description: Award-winning author of The Art of Being Normal, Lisa Williamson brings you a new tale about painfully shy Ro, who’s keeping secrets from her friends. In Brian Conaghan’s The M-Word, Maggie has taken so many hard knocks she’s earned the nickname Conker. Brian and Lisa masterfully capture the voices of closed-off teenagers in a tender, enlightening conversation about grief, resilience and hope.

Title: Horsing Around with Clare Balding
Teaser: Charlie Bass’s best friend Polly has a talent with horses, but after an accident it looks like her skills will go to waste. Can they find a way to make Polly’s equestrian dreams come true? Find out as award-winning broadcaster and equine expert...
Description: Charlie Bass’s best friend Polly has a talent with horses, but after an accident it looks like her skills will go to waste. Can they find a way to make Polly’s equestrian dreams come true? Find out as award-winning broadcaster and equine expert Clare Balding shares the latest book in her series, The Racehorse Who Learned To Dance. Get ready for an hour of hilarious horseplay.

Title: Jason Reynolds & Nikesh Shukla: Left Jab, Write Hook
Teaser: Join this unmissable conversation about finding identity and belonging through sport with award-winning authors Nikesh Shukla and Jason Reynolds. Nikesh's The Boxer was influenced by his work coaching young people in the boxing ring. In Jason's Ghost,...
Description: Join this unmissable conversation about finding identity and belonging through sport with award-winning authors Nikesh Shukla and Jason Reynolds. Nikesh's The Boxer was influenced by his work coaching young people in the boxing ring. In Jason's Ghost, his central character finds solace in running – just as Jason did in poetry and writing. Be inspired by two brilliantly modern, relatable authors.

Title: Darren Shan: Roll Up, Roll Up!
Teaser: Enter the Cirque Du Freak, home of the world’s most remarkable performers. You have your ticket, now take your seat, the show is about to begin… Darren Shan celebrates the 20th anniversary of his worldwide bestselling vampire series by taking you...
Description: Enter the Cirque Du Freak, home of the world’s most remarkable performers. You have your ticket, now take your seat, the show is about to begin… Darren Shan celebrates the 20th anniversary of his worldwide bestselling vampire series by taking you beyond the covers of the first three books. Ask your questions, learn about some scary circus acts and maybe even join in the show.

Title: C A Fletcher & Marcus Sedgwick: Crumbling Worlds
Teaser: Two hopeful stories find richness in barren dystopia. Griz has only met a handful of people in his life, so when his dog is stolen, C A Fletcher takes us to the edge of the world to rescue him. Award-winning author Marcus Sedgwick's desert world,...
Description: Two hopeful stories find richness in barren dystopia. Griz has only met a handful of people in his life, so when his dog is stolen, C A Fletcher takes us to the edge of the world to rescue him. Award-winning author Marcus Sedgwick's desert world, ravaged by illness, challenges stigmas about health. They share the stage to introduce ideas about civilisation and its impact on the planet.

Title: Laura Bates & Patrice Lawrence: Like Wildfire
Teaser: Founder of the Everyday Sexism Project Laura Bates and prize-winning author Patrice Lawrence navigate the maze of teenage girlhood. In Patrice's Rose, Interrupted, a girl escapes a religious sect and plunges into a new world, while Laura's The Burning...
Description: Founder of the Everyday Sexism Project Laura Bates and prize-winning author Patrice Lawrence navigate the maze of teenage girlhood. In Patrice's Rose, Interrupted, a girl escapes a religious sect and plunges into a new world, while Laura's The Burning shows how rumours have always spread like wildfire, from the witch hunts of history to cyberbullying now. They talk informatively about technology, misogyny and staying safe online.

Title: How to Be a Writer For Life
Teaser: Join the Society of Children's Book Writers & Illustrators for a frank discussion about sustaining a writing career in a hugely competitive environment. David Almond is a multi award-winning children's novelist whose work has been adapted for stage and...
Description: Join the Society of Children's Book Writers & Illustrators for a frank discussion about sustaining a writing career in a hugely competitive environment. David Almond is a multi award-winning children's novelist whose work has been adapted for stage and screen. Lauren James signed her first book deal at 21 and is now publishing her fifth novel while still in her 20s. Together they talk about the highs and the lows of their careers.

Title: Gill Lewis & Ruth Tingay: Wildlife Warriors
Teaser: Bobbie and her Gran will stop at nothing to save the golden eagles near their home in the Scottish Highlands, but they're up against some seriously dangerous poachers. Eagle Warrior author Gill Lewis is joined by raptor expert and conservationist Ruth...
Description: Bobbie and her Gran will stop at nothing to save the golden eagles near their home in the Scottish Highlands, but they're up against some seriously dangerous poachers. Eagle Warrior author Gill Lewis is joined by raptor expert and conservationist Ruth Tingay to discuss Ruth's experiences working with the Global Raptor Network and how real events inspired this stunning wilderness story.

Title: Harry Potter Party
Teaser: Apparate into the Harry Potter universe with this fun-filled celebration of all things witchcraft and wizardry, hosted by the incomparable Fleurble Laffalot. Packed with interactive games and fun facts about life at Hogwarts, this Potter-themed party...
Description: Apparate into the Harry Potter universe with this fun-filled celebration of all things witchcraft and wizardry, hosted by the incomparable Fleurble Laffalot. Packed with interactive games and fun facts about life at Hogwarts, this Potter-themed party will have you casting spells to rival any member of Dumbledore’s Army. Grab your broomsticks and wands, dress as your favourite character and find out which house you’ll be sorted into.

Title: 25 Years of Rotten Romans with Martin Brown
Teaser: If you've never read the multi-million bestselling Horrible Histories series, what better place to start than by cracking open the shiny new 25th anniversary edition of Rotten Romans? Illustrator Martin Brown brings this iconic collection of fun facts...
Description: If you've never read the multi-million bestselling Horrible Histories series, what better place to start than by cracking open the shiny new 25th anniversary edition of Rotten Romans? Illustrator Martin Brown brings this iconic collection of fun facts and historical horseplay to life. More accessible than ever, it’s time to recruit the next generation of gory historians.

Title: #PerfectPorridge with Tony Ross & Jeanne Willis
Teaser: Much-loved Little Princess illustrator Tony Ross and award-winning children’s author Jeanne Willis have teamed up on #Goldilocks, a witty look at the dangers of social media. The third in their series of hilarious cautionary tales for young internet...
Description: Much-loved Little Princess illustrator Tony Ross and award-winning children’s author Jeanne Willis have teamed up on #Goldilocks, a witty look at the dangers of social media. The third in their series of hilarious cautionary tales for young internet whizz-kids reimagines Goldilocks as a vlogging superstar. Tony and Jeanne host a lively event perfect for introducing little ones to online safety.

Title: Pamela Butchart: On Stage with the Secret Seven
Teaser: Enid Blyton’s mystery-solving gang are brought into the 21st century with Pamela Butchart's latest spectacular story. The seven are cast in a local play, but things go very wrong on opening night and it’s not just stagefright... The award-winning...
Description: Enid Blyton’s mystery-solving gang are brought into the 21st century with Pamela Butchart's latest spectacular story. The seven are cast in a local play, but things go very wrong on opening night and it’s not just stagefright... The award-winning Baby Aliens author turns her hand brilliantly to this well-known world. A fun, highly interactive event for Secret Seven fans old and new.

Title: David Almond & David Litchfield: War is Over
Teaser: Everyone tells John he’s at war with the Germans, but the little boy he meets doesn’t feel like the enemy… Multi award-winning author of Skellig, David Almond reads from his vivid new story about the end of the First World War. With elegant live...
Description: Everyone tells John he’s at war with the Germans, but the little boy he meets doesn’t feel like the enemy… Multi award-winning author of Skellig, David Almond reads from his vivid new story about the end of the First World War. With elegant live drawing from David Litchfield, this poignant event explores the power of peace and how children get swept up in war.

Title: Alternate Realities with Lauren James & Celia Rees
Teaser: Leave the bounds of the real world with two fast-paced, cinematic adventures that twist until the last page. Learn how Celia Rees, bestselling author of Witch Child, has combined a gaming alternate reality with the writings of the Brontë children, and...
Description: Leave the bounds of the real world with two fast-paced, cinematic adventures that twist until the last page. Learn how Celia Rees, bestselling author of Witch Child, has combined a gaming alternate reality with the writings of the Brontë children, and discover Lauren James’s sci-fi thriller about a declining human race. Two masters of speculative fiction lead you between the real and imagined.

Title: The Deep Blue Sea with Julia Green
Teaser: Wonder at the natural world with Julia Green as she shares her beautiful, lyrical tale about courage, friendship and survival in the face of loss, The House of Light. With her trademark compassion, Julia teaches you important lessons about family and...
Description: Wonder at the natural world with Julia Green as she shares her beautiful, lyrical tale about courage, friendship and survival in the face of loss, The House of Light. With her trademark compassion, Julia teaches you important lessons about family and the environment as she talks about the sense of magic associated with the sea – what it gives us and what it can take away.

Title: Julia Donaldson & Axel Scheffler: The Perfect Mix
Teaser: The award-winning team behind The Gruffalo brings you a colourful event that shoots you into outer space with lots of songs, stories and silliness. Alien tribes the red Smeds and the blue Smoos never mix, but that all comes under threat with a budding...
Description: The award-winning team behind The Gruffalo brings you a colourful event that shoots you into outer space with lots of songs, stories and silliness. Alien tribes the red Smeds and the blue Smoos never mix, but that all comes under threat with a budding romance. Will the colours mix to paint a happy ending? This charming tale is told with humour and read-aloud rhyme.

Title: Dragons and Wizards with Cressida Cowell
Teaser: Set in an ancient past full of mythological creatures, the age-old tale of a boy and girl from opposing tribes who become friends takes on a fantasy adventure twist in the highly anticipated third instalment of master storyteller Cressida Cowell's...
Description: Set in an ancient past full of mythological creatures, the age-old tale of a boy and girl from opposing tribes who become friends takes on a fantasy adventure twist in the highly anticipated third instalment of master storyteller Cressida Cowell's Wizards of Once series. Take your chance to meet the bestselling author of How To Train Your Dragon and ask her your burning questions.

Title: Spuds and Silliness with Sue Hendra & Paul Linnet
Teaser: The supermarket vegetables are planning a colourful carnival, but when their plans are threatened by the dastardly Evil Pea, there's only one starchy superhero who can save the day… Enter Supertato and his gang of plant-based pals, created by...
Description: The supermarket vegetables are planning a colourful carnival, but when their plans are threatened by the dastardly Evil Pea, there's only one starchy superhero who can save the day… Enter Supertato and his gang of plant-based pals, created by bestselling author-illustrator duo Sue Hendra and Paul Linnet. Join in a vibrant vegetable variety show of reading, romps and ridiculousness.

Title: Classroom Capers with Pamela Butchart
Teaser: Class 2R are back for more hilariously chaotic lessons in fun in the fifth book in the Wigglesbottom Primary series. Join in three engaging stories set in the best school in the world – can you help decipher the classroom cat’s secret message? Blue...
Description: Class 2R are back for more hilariously chaotic lessons in fun in the fifth book in the Wigglesbottom Primary series. Join in three engaging stories set in the best school in the world – can you help decipher the classroom cat’s secret message? Blue Peter Award-winning author of The Spy Who Loved School Dinners, Pamela Butchart takes you on a classroom caper where anything could happen.

Title: Facing Fears with Katie Tsang & Kevin Tsang
Teaser: When the school tarantula gets loose, it’s up to Sam Wu to retrieve the eight-legged escapee. Good thing he’s absolutely not afraid of spiders. Or anything at all! Join the authors of Sam Wu is NOT Afraid of Spiders for a fun event that gently deals...
Description: When the school tarantula gets loose, it’s up to Sam Wu to retrieve the eight-legged escapee. Good thing he’s absolutely not afraid of spiders. Or anything at all! Join the authors of Sam Wu is NOT Afraid of Spiders for a fun event that gently deals with common fears: Katie Tsang and Kevin Tsang, whose childhood nerves inspired the series.

Title: Sandy Sandwiches with Philip Ardagh & Elissa Elwick
Teaser: Little Adventurers are brave, honest and kind to nature. Does that sound like you? If so, come along and hear all about their latest escapades at the seaside with Roahl Dahl Funny Prize-winning author Philip Ardagh and illustrator Elissa Elwick. Get...
Description: Little Adventurers are brave, honest and kind to nature. Does that sound like you? If so, come along and hear all about their latest escapades at the seaside with Roahl Dahl Funny Prize-winning author Philip Ardagh and illustrator Elissa Elwick. Get ready for an action-packed, hilarious event perfect for little fans of adventure.

Title: Run Away to the Circus with Katherine Rundell
Teaser: A country girl finds herself in the bustling chaos of New York City, and when the need to exact revenge presents itself, enlists the help of some local circus performers. Join Costa Children's Book Award-winning novelist Katherine Rundell for a lively...
Description: A country girl finds herself in the bustling chaos of New York City, and when the need to exact revenge presents itself, enlists the help of some local circus performers. Join Costa Children's Book Award-winning novelist Katherine Rundell for a lively event in which she tells you all about her experiences learning the flying trapeze while writing The Good Thieves.

Title: Alien Adventures with Tracey Corderoy & Steven Lenton
Teaser: Shifty McGifty and Slippery Sam are back in their latest lively adventure and this time they're using their doggy detective skills to defend against an alien attack. Full of slapstick humour and clever twists, this quirky tale of two canine...
Description: Shifty McGifty and Slippery Sam are back in their latest lively adventure and this time they're using their doggy detective skills to defend against an alien attack. Full of slapstick humour and clever twists, this quirky tale of two canine robbers-turned-bakers is brought alive by the pet lovers behind the hugely successful series: author Tracey Corderoy and illustrator Steven Lenton.

Title: Steve Cole: Toads, Snails and Puppy Dogs' Tails
Teaser: Immensely popular author of Astrosaurs, Steve Cole returns to the Book Festival armed with his customary zany humour and lively performance. Become the sidekick to a wise-quacking superhero in Adventure Duck vs Power Pug and take a foray into the...
Description: Immensely popular author of Astrosaurs, Steve Cole returns to the Book Festival armed with his customary zany humour and lively performance. Become the sidekick to a wise-quacking superhero in Adventure Duck vs Power Pug and take a foray into the beastly habits of Ten Nasty Little Toads. Expect plenty of humour, disgusting facts, quizzes and a cautionary message for naughty little toads who misbehave…

Title: Malorie Blackman: Crossfire
Teaser: One of the UK’s most influential children’s authors, Malorie Blackman brings you the highly anticipated new book in her groundbreaking Noughts & Crosses series, Crossfire. Dealing with racism, politics and terrorism, the series feels as relevant...
Description: One of the UK’s most influential children’s authors, Malorie Blackman brings you the highly anticipated new book in her groundbreaking Noughts & Crosses series, Crossfire. Dealing with racism, politics and terrorism, the series feels as relevant today as when the first book was published 15 years ago. Hear this masterful writer discuss a novel that packs a powerful punch.

Title: Kristina Stephenson: Bear Necessities
Teaser: The bestselling author of Sir Charlie Stinky Socks has a hilarious story to share with her trademark liveliness. The most brilliant minds in the animal kingdom have gathered together to try and answer the impossible question: why are there so many books...
Description: The bestselling author of Sir Charlie Stinky Socks has a hilarious story to share with her trademark liveliness. The most brilliant minds in the animal kingdom have gathered together to try and answer the impossible question: why are there so many books about bears? Expect music, movement and fun galore as you join Kristina Stephenson to get to the bottom of this bear-y important question.

Title: John Boyne: Transitions
Teaser: What do you do when your older brother says he’s not your brother at all, but she’s actually your sister? In My Brother’s Name is Jessica, multi award-winning author of The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas, John Boyne tackles a big topic with warmth and...
Description: What do you do when your older brother says he’s not your brother at all, but she’s actually your sister? In My Brother’s Name is Jessica, multi award-winning author of The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas, John Boyne tackles a big topic with warmth and humour. He tells you why he chose to write about transgender teens and how he hopes books can shine a light on prejudice.

Title: Chris Mould: The Iron Man Reimagined
Teaser: Ted Hughes’s classic The Iron Man is regarded as one of the greatest children’s books of all time. With strong environmental messages, his words are more relevant now than ever. Chris Mould has updated the book to create an exciting new edition for...
Description: Ted Hughes’s classic The Iron Man is regarded as one of the greatest children’s books of all time. With strong environmental messages, his words are more relevant now than ever. Chris Mould has updated the book to create an exciting new edition for the 21st century featuring stunning illustrations. He tells you how he approached reimagining such a timeless tale and shows you some of his striking artwork.

Title: Brave Vampires and Evil Penguins with Laura Ellen Anderson
Teaser: Meet the hilarious characters in author-illustrator Laura Ellen Anderson’s brilliantly imagined tales. Amelia Fang, the bravest little vampire in the kingdom, is back in a gorgeously gothic new story, Amelia Fang and the Half-Moon Holiday. Meanwhile,...
Description: Meet the hilarious characters in author-illustrator Laura Ellen Anderson’s brilliantly imagined tales. Amelia Fang, the bravest little vampire in the kingdom, is back in a gorgeously gothic new story, Amelia Fang and the Half-Moon Holiday. Meanwhile, Evil Emperor Penguin is trying to take over the world from his Antarctic lair. Join Laura and her captivating characters for live drawing and games.

Title: Quirky Animal Characters with Ross Collins
Teaser: Illustrator and author Ross Collins’s new books are guaranteed to have you howling with laughter at their very quirky animal characters. Join Ross for a hilarious hour of live drawing and mischievous animal mayhem as he shares the stories of This is a...
Description: Illustrator and author Ross Collins’s new books are guaranteed to have you howling with laughter at their very quirky animal characters. Join Ross for a hilarious hour of live drawing and mischievous animal mayhem as he shares the stories of This is a Dog and I am a Tiger with you. Expect a cocktail of colourful creatures.

Title: Feminist Fantasy with Deirdre Sullivan & Maria Turtschaninoff
Teaser: Deirdre Sullivan’s Perfectly Preventable Deaths is a lyrical story of witchcraft, sisterhood and sacrifice set in a remote mountain community. Maresi Red Mantle, the thrilling conclusion to Maria Turtschaninoff’s The Red Abbey Chronicles, sees...
Description: Deirdre Sullivan’s Perfectly Preventable Deaths is a lyrical story of witchcraft, sisterhood and sacrifice set in a remote mountain community. Maresi Red Mantle, the thrilling conclusion to Maria Turtschaninoff’s The Red Abbey Chronicles, sees Maresi return to fight for the people in her village with newly learned magic. Meet two authors who have created beautifully crafted fantasy tales with inspiring female characters at their core.

Title: Chris Hoy: Flying Fergus’s Big Finale
Teaser: Strap on your helmet for a fun and fast-paced event celebrating the final book in Olympic champion cyclist Chris Hoy’s fantastic Flying Fergus series. Joined by his writing and illustration team, Joanna Nadin and Clare Elsom, Chris shares stories from...
Description: Strap on your helmet for a fun and fast-paced event celebrating the final book in Olympic champion cyclist Chris Hoy’s fantastic Flying Fergus series. Joined by his writing and illustration team, Joanna Nadin and Clare Elsom, Chris shares stories from the entertaining adventure series all about an ordinary boy and his big cycling dreams.

Title: Warhammer Adventures with Tom Huddleston & Cavan Scott
Teaser: Calling all Warhammer fanatics! Today’s your chance to meet the writers behind two thrilling new Warhammer series – Warped Galaxies and Realm Quest. Tom Huddleston and Cavan Scott’s writing credits include Star Wars: Adventures in Wild Space and...
Description: Calling all Warhammer fanatics! Today’s your chance to meet the writers behind two thrilling new Warhammer series – Warped Galaxies and Realm Quest. Tom Huddleston and Cavan Scott’s writing credits include Star Wars: Adventures in Wild Space and the Doctor Who book series. Now they share their excitement about bringing Warhammer stories to younger readers for the first time. Expect monsters, space battles and dangerous villains.

Title: Change the World with Robert Muchamore
Teaser: International bestselling author Robert Muchamore takes you from London to Lagos in a bold and arresting new book, Arctic Zoo, which follows two teenagers living very different lives, both determined to change the world. Explore important themes of...
Description: International bestselling author Robert Muchamore takes you from London to Lagos in a bold and arresting new book, Arctic Zoo, which follows two teenagers living very different lives, both determined to change the world. Explore important themes of protest, sexuality and mental health with Robert as he talks about this startling contemporary novel and opens up about his own experiences.

Title: Diving into the Deep with Cerrie Burnell
Teaser: Are you ready to go on a brave mission with author and former CBeebies presenter Cerrie Burnell? In The Girl with the Shark’s Teeth, Minnow must venture beneath the waves to find her missing mother. Can a girl who is lost on land find answers in the...
Description: Are you ready to go on a brave mission with author and former CBeebies presenter Cerrie Burnell? In The Girl with the Shark’s Teeth, Minnow must venture beneath the waves to find her missing mother. Can a girl who is lost on land find answers in the Wild Deep? Hear more about the story from Cerrie in an event packed with magic, mermaids and mystery solving.

Title: Cosmic Explorations with Martin Howard & Chris Mould
Teaser: Blast off on an intergalactic adventure with author Martin Howard and illustrator Chris Mould’s fantastically funny travel guide, The Cosmic Atlas of Alfie Fleet. Alfie loves to explore and this time he’s off on a quest beyond his wildest dreams....
Description: Blast off on an intergalactic adventure with author Martin Howard and illustrator Chris Mould’s fantastically funny travel guide, The Cosmic Atlas of Alfie Fleet. Alfie loves to explore and this time he’s off on a quest beyond his wildest dreams. Take a journey to the planet of Outlandish with Martin, before Chris shows you how to draw a brilliant brain in a jar.

Title: Kieran Larwood: Battles and Bunnies
Teaser: Fans of fantasy fiction – and of rabbits – will love Kieran Larwood’s award-winning The Five Realms series. He joins us to talk about The Beasts of Grimheart, the third thrilling instalment of Podkin the rabbit’s epic battle against the Gorm....
Description: Fans of fantasy fiction – and of rabbits – will love Kieran Larwood’s award-winning The Five Realms series. He joins us to talk about The Beasts of Grimheart, the third thrilling instalment of Podkin the rabbit’s epic battle against the Gorm. Who will survive the latest encounter between the enemy sides? Come along to find out more about a brilliantly inventive, magical series.

Title: Teenage Tribulations with William Sutcliffe & Jess Vallance
Teaser: Meet two authors of humorous novels all about surviving your teenage years. The Gifted, the Talented and Me by William Sutcliffe centres on 15 year old Sam who is sent to a new school where he doesn't fit in. Jess Vallance's By Popular Demand follows...
Description: Meet two authors of humorous novels all about surviving your teenage years. The Gifted, the Talented and Me by William Sutcliffe centres on 15 year old Sam who is sent to a new school where he doesn't fit in. Jess Vallance's By Popular Demand follows the embarrassing endeavours of Gracie Dart as she pursues popularity. An event guaranteed to give you a giggle.

Title: Pippa Goodhart & Augusta Kirkwood: Froggy Families
Teaser: Daddy Frog thinks Baby Frog needs lavish gifts – including the moon! But all Baby Frog wants is to spend time with her Daddy. Hear from this lovely, heart-warming tale as award-winning author of the You Choose books, Pippa Goodhart, guides you through...
Description: Daddy Frog thinks Baby Frog needs lavish gifts – including the moon! But all Baby Frog wants is to spend time with her Daddy. Hear from this lovely, heart-warming tale as award-winning author of the You Choose books, Pippa Goodhart, guides you through the story with musical accompaniment from publisher Alan Windram. Then learn how to draw your own froggy creations with illustrator Augusta Kirkwood.

Title: Blast Off with Sheila Kanani
Teaser: Have you got what it takes to become an astronaut, a spaceship engineer or to work at Mission Control? Blast off with award-winning space scientist Sheila Kanani to discover all of the different and incredible space-related jobs that you could do –...
Description: Have you got what it takes to become an astronaut, a spaceship engineer or to work at Mission Control? Blast off with award-winning space scientist Sheila Kanani to discover all of the different and incredible space-related jobs that you could do – from being a space chef to designing spacesuits. An interactive out-of-this-world event perfect for young would-be space explorers.

Title: Frank Cottrell-Boyce: My Automaton Mate
Teaser: Imagine the fun you could have if your best friend was a robot! That’s what CILIP Carnegie Medal winner Frank Cottrell-Boyce explores in his latest heart-warming tale of friendship, Runaway Robot. When Alfie finds Eric, a one-legged robot, in the...
Description: Imagine the fun you could have if your best friend was a robot! That’s what CILIP Carnegie Medal winner Frank Cottrell-Boyce explores in his latest heart-warming tale of friendship, Runaway Robot. When Alfie finds Eric, a one-legged robot, in the airport lost property, there’s no way he’s leaving without him. Come along and discover a hilarious book about a boy and his bionic best pal.

Title: Doggy Dialects with Shoo Rayner
Teaser: When Walker finds his dream job as a dog walker, he discovers he can talk to dogs, which comes in very handy when there are doggy mysteries to be solved. Shoo Rayner has written over 200 books for children and he’s back with a tale that will have you...
Description: When Walker finds his dream job as a dog walker, he discovers he can talk to dogs, which comes in very handy when there are doggy mysteries to be solved. Shoo Rayner has written over 200 books for children and he’s back with a tale that will have you howling with laughter. Hear from the story and watch Shoo draw some of the colourful canines.

Title: Sunshine and Spectres with Alison Moore
Teaser: Sunny is back to solve more ghostly goings-on at the Hotel Splendid. When Ana and her mum check in, they soon discover some unexpected guests and objects that move by themselves… Sharpen up your ghost-hunting skills with lots of engaging activities as...
Description: Sunny is back to solve more ghostly goings-on at the Hotel Splendid. When Ana and her mum check in, they soon discover some unexpected guests and objects that move by themselves… Sharpen up your ghost-hunting skills with lots of engaging activities as Booker Prize-shortlisted author Alison Moore takes you on a tour of this very mysterious hotel.

Title: Journeying to Nowhere with Ross MacKenzie
Teaser: Author Ross MacKenzie introduces the highly anticipated sequel to his Scottish Children’s Book Award-winning The Nowhere Emporium. Venture through the Emporium’s doors with Ross to discover the new wonders waiting for you in the next instalment of...
Description: Author Ross MacKenzie introduces the highly anticipated sequel to his Scottish Children’s Book Award-winning The Nowhere Emporium. Venture through the Emporium’s doors with Ross to discover the new wonders waiting for you in the next instalment of this gripping mystery series. Prepare to be astonished and enthralled in an event full of magic and danger.

Title: Vanishing Vikings with Mike Nicholson
Teaser: Grab your notebook and magnifying glass as you crack another baffling case with Mike Nicholson’s Museum Mystery Squad. The museum is displaying its biggest exhibit yet – a giant Viking longboat. With such a huge attraction, there’s plenty of room...
Description: Grab your notebook and magnifying glass as you crack another baffling case with Mike Nicholson’s Museum Mystery Squad. The museum is displaying its biggest exhibit yet – a giant Viking longboat. With such a huge attraction, there’s plenty of room to hide a secret or two… Join Mike for riddles, red herrings and big reveals as you help solve the latest mystery in his entertaining series.

Title: Gulnar Hajo, Fifi Kuo & Kasia Matyjaszek
Subtitle: Illustration in translation
Teaser: Join our illustrator-in-residence Eilidh Muldoon as she explores picture books in translation, their visual differences and how they can enhance our empathy with and understanding of other cultures. She's joined by Syrian illustrator of Nour's Escape,...
Description: Join our illustrator-in-residence Eilidh Muldoon as she explores picture books in translation, their visual differences and how they can enhance our empathy with and understanding of other cultures. She's joined by Syrian illustrator of Nour's Escape, Gulnar Hajo, Taiwanese creator of Everyone Can Draw, Fifi Kuo, and Kasia Matyjaszek, Polish illustrator of a series of stories about a pirate-girl, Molly Rogers.

Title: Remembering John Burningham
Teaser: This special event celebrates the life and works of the late John Burningham, who won the CILIP Kate Greenaway Medal twice for Mr Gumpy’s Outing and Borka: The Adventures of a Goose with No Feathers. Catherine Rayner, herself a CILIP Kate Greenaway...
Description: This special event celebrates the life and works of the late John Burningham, who won the CILIP Kate Greenaway Medal twice for Mr Gumpy’s Outing and Borka: The Adventures of a Goose with No Feathers. Title: Gobbling Goats with Francesca Simon

Description: Goats eat everything! So when someone leaves their garden gate open, chaos ensues. First goes the food, then the shed, then the fence... Title: 50 Years of The Very Hungry Caterpillar

Title: Create a Giant Iron Man
Teaser: Drop into Story Box to help us create an Iron Man super sculpture. Build a massive version of the iconic character out of different materials, inspired by Chris Mould's stunning new illustrated edition of the book. Lend your ideas to build an Iron Man...
Description: Drop into Story Box to help us create an Iron Man super sculpture. Build a massive version of the iconic character out of different materials, inspired by Chris Mould's stunning new illustrated edition of the book. Lend your ideas to build an Iron Man ready to save the world.

Title: Colourful Canine Drawing
Teaser: Draw along with author and illustrator Shoo Rayner, creator of Walker: The Boy Who Can Talk to Dogs. From loud Labradors to posh Poodles, drop in to join in the doggy drawing fun. You would be barking mad to miss it!
Description: Draw along with author and illustrator Shoo Rayner, creator of Walker: The Boy Who Can Talk to Dogs. From loud Labradors to posh Poodles, drop in to join in the doggy drawing fun. You would be barking mad to miss it!

Title: Build Your Own Butterfly
Teaser: Take a look at some of the beautiful butterfly illustrations in Alice Pattullo’s wonderful The Butterfly House. Then, be inspired to design your own stunning patterned butterfly. Get ready to cut, stick, draw and collage before fluttering off back...
Description: Take a look at some of the beautiful butterfly illustrations in Alice Pattullo’s wonderful The Butterfly House. Then, be inspired to design your own stunning patterned butterfly. Get ready to cut, stick, draw and collage before fluttering off back into the Gardens with a unique butterfly creation.

Title: Big Cat Creations
Teaser: ROARRRR! Drop in and join Big Cat author Emma Lazell to help her create a very big Big Cat. Make sure you place him in his natural surroundings with lots of green and leafy collaging – and be sure to remember to give him his stripes.
Description: ROARRRR! Drop in and join Big Cat author Emma Lazell to help her create a very big Big Cat. Make sure you place him in his natural surroundings with lots of green and leafy collaging – and be sure to remember to give him his stripes.

Title: Amazing Animal Artwork
Teaser: Drop into Story Box to create some animal art inspired by the Book Festival programme, featuring goats, aardvarks, horses, crocodiles and deep sea creatures. Choose your beast from water, land or air and come and contribute to the menagerie.
Description: Drop into Story Box to create some animal art inspired by the Book Festival programme, featuring goats, aardvarks, horses, crocodiles and deep sea creatures. Choose your beast from water, land or air and come and contribute to the menagerie.

Title: Bedlam and Bloodshed with Derek Landy
Teaser: Skeleton detective Skulduggery Pleasant is back for an explosive twelfth escapade in Bedlam, which sees Valkyrie Cain embark on a lawless quest to save her sister’s soul and Omen Darkly attempting to save thousands of innocent lives. Derek Landy...
Description: Skeleton detective Skulduggery Pleasant is back for an explosive twelfth escapade in Bedlam, which sees Valkyrie Cain embark on a lawless quest to save her sister’s soul and Omen Darkly attempting to save thousands of innocent lives. Derek Landy introduces his bestselling series to fans old and new, with readings and activities perfect for ghoulish young readers with a taste for all things undead.

Title: Francesca Simon: Happy Birthday Horrid Henry!
Teaser: Much-loved master of mischief Horrid Henry is back! His award-winning creator Francesca Simon brings you an interactive event bursting with Henry’s hilarious stories, including latest adventure Up, Up and Away. Prepare to giggle your socks off with...
Description: Much-loved master of mischief Horrid Henry is back! His award-winning creator Francesca Simon brings you an interactive event bursting with Henry’s hilarious stories, including latest adventure Up, Up and Away. Prepare to giggle your socks off with these rib-tickling tales of wicked tricks, this year celebrating their 25th birthday. Perfect entertainment for naughty little ones.

Title: Robin Stevens: Unladylike Investigators
Teaser: Become part of the infamous Wells and Wong Detective Society as Robin Stevens introduces you to Daisy and Hazel, two schoolgirls with impeccable crime-solving credentials. In the latest Murder Most Unladylike tale, Deepdean School prepares for an...
Description: Become part of the infamous Wells and Wong Detective Society as Robin Stevens introduces you to Daisy and Hazel, two schoolgirls with impeccable crime-solving credentials. In the latest Murder Most Unladylike tale, Deepdean School prepares for an upcoming reunion, and the girls discover some old grudges with deadly consequences. Put your sleuthing skills to the test in an exciting event from one of the foremost children’s murder mystery writers.

Title: Cheesy Comedy Capers with Jeremy Strong
Teaser: Armadillo and Hare while away their days in the Big Forest eating cheese sandwiches and playing the tuba. Get to know these quirky characters as master of children's comedy and bestselling author Jeremy Strong presents the first book in his whimsically...
Description: Armadillo and Hare while away their days in the Big Forest eating cheese sandwiches and playing the tuba. Get to know these quirky characters as master of children's comedy and bestselling author Jeremy Strong presents the first book in his whimsically funny new series. Expect an energetic event with comedy capers galore.

Title: Alex Bell & Steve Feasey: Discovering Destinies
Teaser: Embark on exciting fantasy adventures with Alex Bell and Steve Feasey as they introduce you to two remarkable worlds with their new series. In Steve's Dark Blade, Lann must defend humanity when the powers of gods fail, while in Alex's Music and Malice...
Description: Embark on exciting fantasy adventures with Alex Bell and Steve Feasey as they introduce you to two remarkable worlds with their new series. In Steve's Dark Blade, Lann must defend humanity when the powers of gods fail, while in Alex's Music and Malice in Hurricane Town, Jude disappears into the city’s gothic underworld after being possessed by a murdered queen. Find out what happens as they face their daunting destinies.

Title: Dive into Reading with Sally Gardner
Teaser: Award-winning author Sally Gardner champions positive debate about dyslexia; her latest book Mr Tiger, Betsy and the Sea Dragon has been printed in a font designed to make reading easier. Join her for an event encouraging struggling readers to dive into...
Description: Award-winning author Sally Gardner champions positive debate about dyslexia; her latest book Mr Tiger, Betsy and the Sea Dragon has been printed in a font designed to make reading easier. Join her for an event encouraging struggling readers to dive into stories, starting with the second adventure for Betsy and Mr Tiger in which they swim with mermaids and confront a wicked pirate.

Title: Invent Your Own Insect
Teaser: Be inspired by Yuval Zommer’s The Big Book of Bugs to drop in and create your own creepy crawly creature. Will you add wings, six eyes or teeth? Join Yuval for interactive insect inventions.
Description: Be inspired by Yuval Zommer’s The Big Book of Bugs to drop in and create your own creepy crawly creature. Will you add wings, six eyes or teeth? Join Yuval for interactive insect inventions.
