Title: Bernardo Atxaga & Margaret Jull Costa
Subtitle: Sin City Through Basque Eyes
Teaser: A chance to travel and write abroad led Basque superstar Bernardo Atxaga to reflect on life back home. Nevada Days is a lightly fictionalised account of a writer-in-residence stint in Reno, brimming with odd events and eccentric characters; it inspired...
Description: A chance to travel and write abroad led Basque superstar Bernardo Atxaga to reflect on life back home. Nevada Days is a lightly fictionalised account of a writer-in-residence stint in Reno, brimming with odd events and eccentric characters; it inspired Atxaga to see himself and his home in unsettling new ways. Today, he is joined by translator Margaret Jull Costa, who brings Atxaga's work to life in English. Part of Scotland Goes Basque 2019.

Title: Patrick Flanery & Adam Foulds
Subtitle: Life on the Brink
Teaser: Two Book Festival favourites make a welcome return. Patrick Flanery presents Night For Day, a McCarthy-era tale of Hollywood friends facing the blacklist before they can complete their noir retelling of the Orpheus myth. Adam Foulds, one of Granta’s...
Description: Two Book Festival favourites make a welcome return. Patrick Flanery presents Night For Day, a McCarthy-era tale of Hollywood friends facing the blacklist before they can complete their noir retelling of the Orpheus myth. Adam Foulds, one of Granta’s 2013 Best of Young British Novelists, is back with his witty Dream Sequence. A young actor on the cusp of superstardom faces grave consequences for his pursuit of fame. They talk to Polly Clark about their new books.

Title: Joanna Kavenna & Alan Trotter
Subtitle: Fake News and Fever Dreams
Teaser: Fizzing new fiction sheds fresh light on worlds we thought we knew. Joanna Kavenna has been described as ‘a true literary insurgent’. Her new novel Zed dives into the dark web of connections between tech giants and governments. Edinburgh-based Alan...
Description: Fizzing new fiction sheds fresh light on worlds we thought we knew. Joanna Kavenna has been described as ‘a true literary insurgent’. Her new novel Zed dives into the dark web of connections between tech giants and governments. Edinburgh-based Alan Trotter’s debut Muscle is a compelling slice of pulp fiction, a mind-altering experiment in noir that sits somewhere between a Borges mystery and a David Lynch nightmare.

Title: Adam Rutherford
Subtitle: The Human League
Teaser: What is the difference between animal and human? Is there a clear distinction between the two? Popular science writer and broadcaster Adam Rutherford, co-host of BBC Radio 4’s Inside Science, offers some answers today. In The Book of Humans he...
Description: What is the difference between animal and human? Is there a clear distinction between the two? Popular science writer and broadcaster Adam Rutherford, co-host of BBC Radio 4’s Inside Science, offers some answers today. In The Book of Humans he explores the evolution of homo sapiens and the traits that make our species unique, from our relationships with sex and war to our cultural totems. Chaired by Pete Etchells.

Title: Jan-Philipp Sendker
Subtitle: Chinese Whispers
Teaser: Few things could be more terrifying than a threat against your child’s safety. That’s the propulsive force behind Jan-Philipp Sendker’s gripping thriller The Far Side of the Night, the last in the bestselling Rising Dragon series. Paul and...
Description: Few things could be more terrifying than a threat against your child’s safety. That’s the propulsive force behind Jan-Philipp Sendker’s gripping thriller The Far Side of the Night, the last in the bestselling Rising Dragon series. Paul and Christine are many miles from the sanctuary of China’s US Embassy, in need of help and unable to trust the strangers around them. Sendker takes us deep into the soul of modern China.

Title: Gruesome Greeks with Chae Strathie
Teaser: If you’ve got a passion for horrible history, then join award-winning author Chae Strathie as he takes you back in time to ancient Greece to find out what life was like for kids. You might be picturing sunshine and Olympic sports, but think again,...
Description: If you’ve got a passion for horrible history, then join award-winning author Chae Strathie as he takes you back in time to ancient Greece to find out what life was like for kids. You might be picturing sunshine and Olympic sports, but think again, blood soup diets and memorising epic poetry is more like it! Get ready for a hilarious, interactive take on all things Greek.

Title: Lauren Beard & Abie Longstaff: Fabulous Fairy Tales
Teaser: Author and illustrator double act Abie Longstaff and Lauren Beard are back with the latest enchanting tale in their Fairytale Hairdresser series. This time round, Thumbelina is missing and it’s up to Kittie Lacey, the best hairdresser in all of...
Description: Author and illustrator double act Abie Longstaff and Lauren Beard are back with the latest enchanting tale in their Fairytale Hairdresser series. This time round, Thumbelina is missing and it’s up to Kittie Lacey, the best hairdresser in all of Fairyland, to save the day. Hear Abie read from the stylish story, watch Lauren do some designer live drawing and get involved with some classy crafts.

Title: Laura Ellen Anderson: Size Doesn’t Matter
Teaser: Have you ever wished you could be a little bit taller? Or are you tired of towering over your friends? In Laura Ellen Anderson’s latest picture book, I Don’t Want to be Small, you'll discover that people come in all shapes and sizes. The...
Description: Have you ever wished you could be a little bit taller? Or are you tired of towering over your friends? In Laura Ellen Anderson’s latest picture book, I Don’t Want to be Small, you'll discover that people come in all shapes and sizes. The author-illustrator of the bestselling Amelia Fang series teaches you to love who you are, no matter whether small or tall.

Title: Sophy Henn: Bad Nana is Back
Teaser: Waterstones Children’s Book Prize-shortlisted author Sophy Henn has brought everyone’s favourite Bad Nana back for a wickedly funny romp in All the Fun of the Fair. Jeanie’s nana is very naughty, but it's hard not to be in hysterics at her latest...
Description: Waterstones Children’s Book Prize-shortlisted author Sophy Henn has brought everyone’s favourite Bad Nana back for a wickedly funny romp in All the Fun of the Fair. Jeanie’s nana is very naughty, but it's hard not to be in hysterics at her latest escapades. Sophy takes you inside the covers of the second book in her gorgeously illustrated series. Grab your granny and get involved.

Title: Discovering D-Day with Michael Noble
Teaser: Experience the dramatic events of a major turning point in the Second World War as you uncover the diverse stories of those who were there, including soldiers and civilians. To mark the 75th anniversary of D-Day, Michael Noble has collected amazing...
Description: Experience the dramatic events of a major turning point in the Second World War as you uncover the diverse stories of those who were there, including soldiers and civilians. To mark the 75th anniversary of D-Day, Michael Noble has collected amazing photographs and personal accounts from this momentous day in history. He’s here to share them with you in this dynamic event.

Title: Sophy Henn: Super Duper Unique You
Teaser: Celebrate the varied and wonderful things that make each of us unique in this positive, inclusive event with highly acclaimed children’s illustrator Sophy Henn. She reads rhymes from her latest book, Super Duper You, and shows you her bright and...
Description: Celebrate the varied and wonderful things that make each of us unique in this positive, inclusive event with highly acclaimed children’s illustrator Sophy Henn. She reads rhymes from her latest book, Super Duper You, and shows you her bright and vibrant illustrations, which get you thinking about what makes you so super. Expect a joyful hour of colour and creativity.

Title: Creating Cartoons with Jamie Littler
Teaser: Are you crazy for cartoons? Now’s your chance to create your own in illustrator Jamie Littler's interactive drawing workshop. Jamie is the man behind the drawings in Cogg and Sprokit, serialised in the Phoenix comic for two years, and the multi...
Description: Are you crazy for cartoons? Now’s your chance to create your own in illustrator Jamie Littler's interactive drawing workshop. Jamie is the man behind the drawings in Cogg and Sprokit, serialised in the Phoenix comic for two years, and the multi award-winning Hamish series, authored by Danny Wallace. He gives you handy hints and insider tips for making your own unforgettable cartoon masterpiece.

Title: Mystery Solving with Abie Longstaff
Teaser: Orphan Tally is the servant girl at Mollett Manor, but she’s also the Secret Keeper of the magical library hidden beneath the grounds. In the latest of Abie Longstaff’s Trapdoor Mysteries, Tally and her trusty sidekick Squill the squirrel must solve...
Description: Orphan Tally is the servant girl at Mollett Manor, but she’s also the Secret Keeper of the magical library hidden beneath the grounds. In the latest of Abie Longstaff’s Trapdoor Mysteries, Tally and her trusty sidekick Squill the squirrel must solve the mystery of a kidnapped dog. Crack codes and solve secret puzzles with Abie as she introduces you to her intelligent, inquisitive heroine.

Title: Clare Elsom: Friends, Romans, Statues!
Teaser: Seven year old Harriet and 17th century statue Horace – the best of friends – are back and this time Horace is making quite an exhibition of himself in Rome. Illustrator of Chris Hoy’s Flying Fergus, Clare Elsom brings the latest book in her...
Description: Seven year old Harriet and 17th century statue Horace – the best of friends – are back and this time Horace is making quite an exhibition of himself in Rome. Illustrator of Chris Hoy’s Flying Fergus, Clare Elsom brings the latest book in her humorous and heart-warming series to life with live drawing and gets you joining in the illustration fun.

Title: Make Your Own Comic with Gary Chudleigh & Tanya Roberts
Teaser: Two talented comic creators lead you into colourful worlds in this comic-making workshop. As well as their joint series Plagued, Tanya Roberts has worked as an artist on Star Wars: The Clone Wars and Titan Comics’s How To Train Your Dragon, while Gary...
Description: Two talented comic creators lead you into colourful worlds in this comic-making workshop. As well as their joint series Plagued, Tanya Roberts has worked as an artist on Star Wars: The Clone Wars and Titan Comics’s How To Train Your Dragon, while Gary Chudleigh has illustrated for comic publishers DC Thomson and Futureshock. Today, they develop your drawing and visual storytelling skills.

Title: Dave Cousins: Rollicking Robots
Teaser: Expect madness and mayhem as Dave Cousins introduces you to his latest laugh-out-loud book, My Babysitter is a Robot. When Grandma invents a robot to take care of Jake and Jess, chaos ensues! But when someone tries to steal him, they must put their...
Description: Expect madness and mayhem as Dave Cousins introduces you to his latest laugh-out-loud book, My Babysitter is a Robot. When Grandma invents a robot to take care of Jake and Jess, chaos ensues! But when someone tries to steal him, they must put their sibling squabbles aside to bring him home. Find out if they succeed in a hilarious event about teamwork, sibling rivalry and bionic babysitters.

Title: Under the Bed with Elizabeth Laird
Teaser: Amir is frightened of the monster living under his bed. What if it tries to eat him in the night? Perhaps he should try to befriend him instead… Multi award-winning author Elizabeth Laird presents her timeless picture book tale Grobblechops, based on...
Description: Amir is frightened of the monster living under his bed. What if it tries to eat him in the night? Perhaps he should try to befriend him instead… Multi award-winning author Elizabeth Laird presents her timeless picture book tale Grobblechops, based on a 13th century Rumi story. Join her for a dreamy event about friendship and conquering fears.

Title: Pippa Goodhart: Sharing's Caring
Teaser: Hare and Bear are trying to reach some juicy pears in the tree, but they only have three chairs to help. How can they split the chairs fairly? Award-winning author Pippa Goodhart shares her beautiful new picture book Fair Shares with you today as you...
Description: Hare and Bear are trying to reach some juicy pears in the tree, but they only have three chairs to help. How can they split the chairs fairly? Award-winning author Pippa Goodhart shares her beautiful new picture book Fair Shares with you today as you consider a tricky topic – what is fair? The answer might not be as simple as you think…

Title: Courageous Crabs with Chris Haughton
Teaser: The multi award-winning creator of much-loved picture books including A Bit Lost and Goodnight Everyone introduces you to the courageous character from his brand new book Don’t Worry, Little Crab. Little Crab is excited to go for a dip in the sea…...
Description: The multi award-winning creator of much-loved picture books including A Bit Lost and Goodnight Everyone introduces you to the courageous character from his brand new book Don’t Worry, Little Crab. Little Crab is excited to go for a dip in the sea… until he sees the enormous waves! Chris Haughton shows you how he creates his wonderful under-the-sea illustrations and talks about conquering your fears.

Title: Tom Huddleston & Jamie Smith: Futuristic Fantasy Worlds
Teaser: Film critic and Star Wars: Adventures in Wild Space author, Tom Huddleston discusses his cinematic new work Floodworld with Jamie Smith, whose debut Frostfire was shortlisted for the Times/Chicken House Children’s Fiction Competition. The futuristic...
Description: Film critic and Star Wars: Adventures in Wild Space author, Tom Huddleston discusses his cinematic new work Floodworld with Jamie Smith, whose debut Frostfire was shortlisted for the Times/Chicken House Children’s Fiction Competition. The futuristic fantasy worlds that they spin take you on journeys from the depths of an underwater city to merciless mountain summits. They unlock the secrets of writing compelling adventures.

Title: Alice Pattullo: Spread Your Wings
Teaser: Step inside The Butterfly House with Alice Pattullo and take a look at some of her intricate illustrations of the world’s most beautiful insect. Learn lots of fantastic facts about butterflies, moths and caterpillars, and have a go at drawing some of...
Description: Step inside The Butterfly House with Alice Pattullo and take a look at some of her intricate illustrations of the world’s most beautiful insect. Learn lots of fantastic facts about butterflies, moths and caterpillars, and have a go at drawing some of your own. The perfect introduction to these wonderful, winged insects for little ones.

Title: Gill Arbuthnott: Countdown to the Moon
Teaser: To mark the 50th anniversary of the moon landing, science teacher-turned-author Gill Arbuthnott guides you through a fascinating countdown of the technologies, innovations and stories that led humans from hot air balloons to walking on the moon. Learn...
Description: To mark the 50th anniversary of the moon landing, science teacher-turned-author Gill Arbuthnott guides you through a fascinating countdown of the technologies, innovations and stories that led humans from hot air balloons to walking on the moon. Learn about some of humankind’s most amazing inventions and then let your imagination run wild as you consider what might be possible in the future.

Title: Jill Calder: Our Blue Planet
Teaser: Jill Calder takes you on a deep dive into her illustrated underwater world. The Sea pairs her award-winning illustrations with stories and facts from the BBC’s Miranda Krestovnikoff about our blue planet and how to protect it. Combining mesmerising...
Description: Jill Calder takes you on a deep dive into her illustrated underwater world. The Sea pairs her award-winning illustrations with stories and facts from the BBC’s Miranda Krestovnikoff about our blue planet and how to protect it. Combining mesmerising drawing with fascinating scientific information, Jill inspires you with top tips for helping to save our magical oceans.

Title: Feisty Felines and Honest Hounds with Kimberlie Hamilton
Teaser: Discover lots of fur-raising facts and tail-wagging tales with Kimberlie Hamilton as you delve into the pages of her fantastic collections, Rebel Cats! and Rebel Dogs! Hear lots of stories and secrets about history’s most fascinating felines and...
Description: Discover lots of fur-raising facts and tail-wagging tales with Kimberlie Hamilton as you delve into the pages of her fantastic collections, Rebel Cats! and Rebel Dogs! Hear lots of stories and secrets about history’s most fascinating felines and heroic hounds, including an astrocat that travelled in space and an internet-sensation pup. The paw-fect event for animal lovers everywhere.

Title: Elizabeth Laird: Rebuilding as a Refugee
Teaser: Following the success of her novel Welcome to Nowhere, based on her time spent in Jordanian refugee camps, Elizabeth Laird returns with a powerful story set amidst the Syrian refugee crisis. Hear her discuss the themes of family, hope and redemption...
Description: Following the success of her novel Welcome to Nowhere, based on her time spent in Jordanian refugee camps, Elizabeth Laird returns with a powerful story set amidst the Syrian refugee crisis. Hear her discuss the themes of family, hope and redemption found in A House Without Walls, which follows a young girl attempting to rebuild her life after being driven out of her country by civil war.

Title: Scots Rhymetime
Teaser: Join Craigmillar Books for Babies for a fun and lively sing-along as they share their favourite rhymes and songs in Scots. With lots of laughs and language learning, this event is ideal for families with children under the age of four.
Description: Join Craigmillar Books for Babies for a fun and lively sing-along as they share their favourite rhymes and songs in Scots. With lots of laughs and language learning, this event is ideal for families with children under the age of four.

Title: Rhymetime
Teaser: Join Craigmillar Books for Babies for a fun and lively sing-along as they share their favourite rhymes and songs. With lots of laughs and language development, this event is ideal for families with children under four.
Description: Join Craigmillar Books for Babies for a fun and lively sing-along as they share their favourite rhymes and songs. With lots of laughs and language development, this event is ideal for families with children under four.

Title: Tom Morgan-Jones: The Red Dread
Teaser: Tom Morgan-Jones's debut picture book comes to Edinburgh in an energetic, interactive event full of live drawing and storytelling. Follow the story and draw along with Tom as a friendly group of animals falls into panic when they hear the notorious...
Description: Tom Morgan-Jones's debut picture book comes to Edinburgh in an energetic, interactive event full of live drawing and storytelling. Follow the story and draw along with Tom as a friendly group of animals falls into panic when they hear the notorious ‘thump’ of the Red Dread – a spooky monster lurking in their midst. Watch a quirky tale bursting with visual humour brought to life.

Title: Freedom of Imagination with Gulnar Hajo
Teaser: Free your mind with a book beautifully illustrated by Syrian-born Gulnar Hajo. Nour’s Escape follows a little girl with no family, no home and seemingly no escape. But as the story criss-crosses fantasy and reality, you’ll discover how freeing a...
Description: Free your mind with a book beautifully illustrated by Syrian-born Gulnar Hajo. Nour’s Escape follows a little girl with no family, no home and seemingly no escape. But as the story criss-crosses fantasy and reality, you’ll discover how freeing a little imagination can be. Watch as Gulnar shows you how she created the stunning images to accompany this original tale.

Title: Tiny Tigers with Emma Lazell
Teaser: In a brilliantly funny debut by Emma Lazell, Gran and Isobel find a surprise in their garden, a new cat… a very BIG new cat indeed. Join in their colourful adventures with an exciting array of arts and crafts: collage your own Big Cat mask or add to...
Description: In a brilliantly funny debut by Emma Lazell, Gran and Isobel find a surprise in their garden, a new cat… a very BIG new cat indeed. Join in their colourful adventures with an exciting array of arts and crafts: collage your own Big Cat mask or add to the giant cat picture created with paints, chalks and more.

Title: Maria Isabel Sánchez Vegara: Little People, Big Games
Teaser: Maria Isabel Sánchez Vegara is the author of the inspirational Little People, Big Dreams series all about characters from history and how they came to achieve their childhood dreams. To introduce you to some of these amazing people, Maria invites you...
Description: Maria Isabel Sánchez Vegara is the author of the inspirational Little People, Big Dreams series all about characters from history and how they came to achieve their childhood dreams. To introduce you to some of these amazing people, Maria invites you to join in a gigantic game of Guess Who?. Match fun facts with the famous faces from her books including Maya Angelou, Frida Kahlo and Stephen Hawking.

Title: Konnie Huq: Silly Science
Teaser: As the longest serving female Blue Peter presenter, Konnie Huq is used to hearing young people's stories. Now for the first time, she has written her own story, Cookie, about a British-Bangladeshi girl who dreams of being a scientist. Filled with madcap...
Description: As the longest serving female Blue Peter presenter, Konnie Huq is used to hearing young people's stories. Now for the first time, she has written her own story, Cookie, about a British-Bangladeshi girl who dreams of being a scientist. Filled with madcap humour and sensational science, this dynamic, energetic event will have you laughing out loud.

Title: Duncan Beedie: A Moth’s Moon Mission
Teaser: Molly the moth yearns for adventure; she longs to visit the moon. She knows it’s no easy feat for one little moth, but she’s not one to give up on her dreams. Celebrate the hilarious endeavours of a tiny moth’s big journey with author-illustrator...
Description: Molly the moth yearns for adventure; she longs to visit the moon. She knows it’s no easy feat for one little moth, but she’s not one to give up on her dreams. Celebrate the hilarious endeavours of a tiny moth’s big journey with author-illustrator of Molly's Moon Mission, Duncan Beedie. Expect an out-of-this world hour as you take one giant leap for mothkind with Molly.

Title: Splashing Around with Duncan Beedie & Wendy Meddour
Teaser: Meet the hero of the inky deep for a high-powered under-the-sea adventure. The team from Deep Sea TV never seem to notice Stefano, but can this ordinary squid dig deep and find the superhero inside? Wendy Quill author Wendy Meddour and The Bear Who...
Description: Meet the hero of the inky deep for a high-powered under-the-sea adventure. The team from Deep Sea TV never seem to notice Stefano, but can this ordinary squid dig deep and find the superhero inside? Wendy Quill author Wendy Meddour and The Bear Who Stared illustrator Duncan Beedie take you on a deep sea dive into all things aquatic with a story that makes a big splash.

Title: Mouse and Mole with James Mayhew
Teaser: James Mayhew draws you into the vivid world of the wonderful Mouse and Mole series. Discover how the bestselling illustrator created the much-loved characters to match Joyce Dunbar's witty stories about two furry best friends. With warmth and humour,...
Description: James Mayhew draws you into the vivid world of the wonderful Mouse and Mole series. Discover how the bestselling illustrator created the much-loved characters to match Joyce Dunbar's witty stories about two furry best friends. With warmth and humour, James shows you how you too can create colourful animal characters to decorate your stories.

Title: Understanding Migration with Petr Horáček
Teaser: Award-winning picture book creator and Festival favourite, Petr Horáček returns with his latest stunning work, Migrations. Opening up discussions about human migration, the book depicts the migration routes of birds through the artwork and words of...
Description: Award-winning picture book creator and Festival favourite, Petr Horáček returns with his latest stunning work, Migrations. Opening up discussions about human migration, the book depicts the migration routes of birds through the artwork and words of over 50 illustrators and famous voices. Today, Petr shows you how to recreate some of the stunning images.

Title: Scintillating Science with Christopher Edge
Teaser: Christopher Edge's critically acclaimed fiction blends heart-warming stories with scientific knowledge. Following on from The Many Worlds of Albie Bright, his new book about time proves again that science can be thrilling and fun. Join him for an...
Description: Christopher Edge's critically acclaimed fiction blends heart-warming stories with scientific knowledge. Following on from The Many Worlds of Albie Bright, his new book about time proves again that science can be thrilling and fun. Join him for an interactive event packed full of mind-bending facts and sensational science as he introduces The Longest Night of Charlie Noon.

Title: High Flying Fun with Yuval Zommer
Teaser: Yuval Zommer introduces the latest in his immensely popular Big Book series and this time it’s all about birds. Packed with illustrations and flighty facts about our feathered friends, from peacocks to pigeons and flamingos to fairy wrens, a whole...
Description: Yuval Zommer introduces the latest in his immensely popular Big Book series and this time it’s all about birds. Packed with illustrations and flighty facts about our feathered friends, from peacocks to pigeons and flamingos to fairy wrens, a whole aviary is about to be released. After an interactive reading and live illustration, take the chance to create your own colourful winged creature.

Title: Andy Seed: Doodoo Detectives
Teaser: Become an expert tracker and poo-identifier with handy field guide to droppings, tracks and traces, The Clue is in the Poo. Fact-filled funnyman Andy Seed won the 2015 Blue Peter Best Book with Facts Award and has now turned his attention to the natural...
Description: Become an expert tracker and poo-identifier with handy field guide to droppings, tracks and traces, The Clue is in the Poo. Fact-filled funnyman Andy Seed won the 2015 Blue Peter Best Book with Facts Award and has now turned his attention to the natural world and all it leaves behind. Get the scoop on poop with an interactive quiz where you’ll identify animals from their… clues.

Title: Good Knight, Bad Knight, Tom Knight!
Teaser: Hold onto your helmets for an armour-splittingly funny event with hilarious creator of the Good Knight, Bad Knight series, Tom Knight, as he progresses his heroic characters from picture books into longer fiction. The two rival knight cousins are total...
Description: Hold onto your helmets for an armour-splittingly funny event with hilarious creator of the Good Knight, Bad Knight series, Tom Knight, as he progresses his heroic characters from picture books into longer fiction. The two rival knight cousins are total opposites but they must work together to overcome dragons, stinkbombs, barbarians and more. Come along to see the laugh-out-loud consequences.

Title: Elizabeth Jones & Eloise Williams: Magic and Meaning
Teaser: Elizabeth Jones's A Dark Iris sees Rebekah learn the violent history of her homeland through magical appearances in her artwork. In Eloise Williams's Seaglass, Lark confronts a long-buried family secret after an outdoor expedition turns into a chilling...
Description: Elizabeth Jones's A Dark Iris sees Rebekah learn the violent history of her homeland through magical appearances in her artwork. In Eloise Williams's Seaglass, Lark confronts a long-buried family secret after an outdoor expedition turns into a chilling ghost story. Elizabeth and Eloise lead you on a mystical journey of understanding as they discuss how magic can be used to explore real life hardships.

Title: The Big Droppings Drop-In
Teaser: Join Andy Seed, hilarious author of The Clue is in the Poo, for a big drop-in drawing event all about droppings. Can you use your nature knowledge to match the animal pictures with their poos? Get ready for cutting, sticking, drawing and colouring –...
Description: Join Andy Seed, hilarious author of The Clue is in the Poo, for a big drop-in drawing event all about droppings. Can you use your nature knowledge to match the animal pictures with their poos? Get ready for cutting, sticking, drawing and colouring – don't leave any droppings behind!

Title: Jane Foster: From Rabbits to Raptors
Teaser: Acclaimed artist Jane Foster’s colourful books provide teaching for tots about new experiences. Her latest two focus on animal kingdoms – alive and extinct – with Pets and Dinosaurs. With vibrant, stylish artwork, these bold board books introduce...
Description: Acclaimed artist Jane Foster’s colourful books provide teaching for tots about new experiences. Her latest two focus on animal kingdoms – alive and extinct – with Pets and Dinosaurs. With vibrant, stylish artwork, these bold board books introduce you to an array of new friends from rabbits to raptors. See Jane draw some of her vivid images and get hands-on with fun craft activities.

Title: Emer Stamp: Pig and Pals
Teaser: Learn to draw the colourful characters from Emer Stamp’s rip-roaring Diary of Pig series. Get ready to run away and join the farm with Pig and his pals for lots of bonkers adventures. Pick up a pencil and get top tips from the creative mind behind the...
Description: Learn to draw the colourful characters from Emer Stamp’s rip-roaring Diary of Pig series. Get ready to run away and join the farm with Pig and his pals for lots of bonkers adventures. Pick up a pencil and get top tips from the creative mind behind the John Lewis Christmas adverts.

Title: Emer Stamp: Fartypants Fun
Teaser: All dads are embarrassing, but imagine if yours constantly farted everywhere you went! Emer Stamp will have you laughing your pants off with her very windy bear creation and this stinky half hour of storytime silliness. Emer is the writer behind the...
Description: All dads are embarrassing, but imagine if yours constantly farted everywhere you went! Emer Stamp will have you laughing your pants off with her very windy bear creation and this stinky half hour of storytime silliness. Emer is the writer behind the hilarious bestselling Diary of Pig series, and this latest story promises to be another trumping triumph.

Title: Morag Hood: Aadorable Aardvarks
Teaser: Two-time Macmillan Prize winner and Edinburgh local, Morag Hood appears at the Book Festival this year in an event packed with her mischievous humour and original picture books. Brenda is a Sheep is a witty retelling of the idea of a wolf in sheep’s...
Description: Two-time Macmillan Prize winner and Edinburgh local, Morag Hood appears at the Book Festival this year in an event packed with her mischievous humour and original picture books. Brenda is a Sheep is a witty retelling of the idea of a wolf in sheep’s clothing and Aalfred and Aalbert is an aadorable romance between two aardvarks, both of which feature Morag’s memorable illustrations.

Title: Andrew Clover: Seriously Deadly Escapades
Teaser: Described by Adam Baron as the 'perfect link between picture books and full-length novels', Andrew Clover's hilarious comedy-crime series Rory Branagan is all about the best detective in town. Today, the actor, comedian and author tells you about the...
Description: Described by Adam Baron as the 'perfect link between picture books and full-length novels', Andrew Clover's hilarious comedy-crime series Rory Branagan is all about the best detective in town. Today, the actor, comedian and author tells you about the most recent instalments in Rory's seriously deadly escapades in a brilliantly lively event of storytelling and silliness.

Title: CSI: Crime Squirrel Investigators with Emily Dodd
Teaser: Bestselling children’s author and CBeebies screenwriter, Emily Dodd brings her scientific knowledge to this quirky investigative event. Through energetic storytelling, you'll learn how to identify different animals as you help the Crime Squirrel...
Description: Bestselling children’s author and CBeebies screenwriter, Emily Dodd brings her scientific knowledge to this quirky investigative event. Through energetic storytelling, you'll learn how to identify different animals as you help the Crime Squirrel Investigators catch the naughty nut thief. Plus, get ready to join in the woodpecker hip hop track as Emily sings, raps and plays guitar.

Title: Joseph Coelho: Warm-Hearted Words
Teaser: Hear award-winning performance poet Joseph Coelho share an uplifting story about the importance of being yourself. With sensitivity and warmth, Joseph encourages little ones to get to grips with big topics, including loss. Expect lots of rhymes and...
Description: Hear award-winning performance poet Joseph Coelho share an uplifting story about the importance of being yourself. With sensitivity and warmth, Joseph encourages little ones to get to grips with big topics, including loss. Expect lots of rhymes and tales in this gentle and positive event, perfect for encouraging open and honest conversations about your emotions.

Title: Meet Shiny Pippin with Harry Heape
Teaser: Harry Heape takes you back in time on strange and silly adventures with his hilarious new series about a little girl called Pippin who is quite the opposite of ordinary… she's Shiny! And that means she has very special powers. With topsy-turvy...
Description: Harry Heape takes you back in time on strange and silly adventures with his hilarious new series about a little girl called Pippin who is quite the opposite of ordinary… she's Shiny! And that means she has very special powers. With topsy-turvy illustrations, these chaotic tales jump off the page. Join Harry for an event that will tickle your funny bone and put a big smile on your face.

Title: Adam Guillain & Charlotte Guillain: Day for Dads
Teaser: The joyful rhyming follow-up to School for Dads is here. Get your dad dancing ready as you join a big celebration of fathers everywhere in Party for Dads. Bestselling authors of George's Amazing Adventures, Adam and Charlotte Guillain get you joining in...
Description: The joyful rhyming follow-up to School for Dads is here. Get your dad dancing ready as you join a big celebration of fathers everywhere in Party for Dads. Bestselling authors of George's Amazing Adventures, Adam and Charlotte Guillain get you joining in the story and imagining a world where kids and dads swap places. A hilarious, interactive hour to enjoy with the old man.

Title: Sita Brahmachari & Jane Ray: Isla's Islands
Teaser: When Isla's family whisk her away from Edinburgh to live on the Orkney Islands, she is surprised to find legends and natural beauty that help her make sense of her dual-heritage and her family’s loss. Author Sita Brahmachari shares the important...
Description: When Isla's family whisk her away from Edinburgh to live on the Orkney Islands, she is surprised to find legends and natural beauty that help her make sense of her dual-heritage and her family’s loss. Author Sita Brahmachari shares the important lessons from her heart-warming tale with you, as illustrator Jane Ray brings her stunning Orkney illustrations to life in front of your eyes.

Title: A Hummingbird History with Nicola Davies & Jane Ray
Teaser: Did you know that a hummingbird is smaller than your thumb and weighs less than a 20 pence piece? Award-winning nature author Nicola Davies and CILIP Kate Greenaway Medal nominee Jane Ray teach you lots of fascinating facts about these magical little...
Description: Did you know that a hummingbird is smaller than your thumb and weighs less than a 20 pence piece? Award-winning nature author Nicola Davies and CILIP Kate Greenaway Medal nominee Jane Ray teach you lots of fascinating facts about these magical little creatures in their exquisite storybook Hummingbird. Expertly blending fact with fiction, this engaging event is perfect for budding zoologists and nature lovers.

Title: Gallop through History with Saviour Pirotta
Teaser: Maltese author Saviour Pirotta takes you on a historical mystery adventure across the globe. Dip into the world of the ancient Greeks with Shadows of the Centaurs and the Middle East circa 900AD with The Golden Horsemen of Baghdad. Expect high-powered...
Description: Maltese author Saviour Pirotta takes you on a historical mystery adventure across the globe. Dip into the world of the ancient Greeks with Shadows of the Centaurs and the Middle East circa 900AD with The Golden Horsemen of Baghdad. Expect high-powered drama and fascinating historical facts in this exciting event, as Saviour tells you all about his ancient tales.

Title: Make Your Own Cuddly Cat
Teaser: Not everyone is lucky enough to have a pet at home – so now's your chance to make one! Drop in and join The Pawed Piper author Michelle Robinson to make your own cuddly cat creation. From ping pong balls to pipe cleaners, we've got everything to help...
Description: Not everyone is lucky enough to have a pet at home – so now's your chance to make one! Drop in and join The Pawed Piper author Michelle Robinson to make your own cuddly cat creation. From ping pong balls to pipe cleaners, we've got everything to help you create your perfect pet.

Title: Nicola Davies: Country Comforts
Teaser: Nicola Davies is the multi award-winning author of beautiful, informative stories about the natural world, including CILIP Kate Greenaway Medal-longlisted Perfect and The Pond. Today, she takes you on a romp into the wild with fun activities and...
Description: Nicola Davies is the multi award-winning author of beautiful, informative stories about the natural world, including CILIP Kate Greenaway Medal-longlisted Perfect and The Pond. Today, she takes you on a romp into the wild with fun activities and readings from the latest books in her Country Tales series about children growing up in the countryside and making sense of a changing world.

Title: The Flying Circus with Peter Bunzl
Teaser: Let your imagination be carried far, far away by the travelling Skycircus. When the troupe descend on Lily and Robert's hometown, with their astounding acts and clockwork wonders, mystery and mayhem await. BAFTA-winning animator-turned-children’s...
Description: Let your imagination be carried far, far away by the travelling Skycircus. When the troupe descend on Lily and Robert's hometown, with their astounding acts and clockwork wonders, mystery and mayhem await. BAFTA-winning animator-turned-children’s author, Peter Bunzl hosts a highly visual event based on the awe-inspiring world of his bestselling Cogheart series.

Title: Centuries of Shenanigans with Philip Ardagh
Teaser: Award-winning author Philip Ardagh combines fact and fiction in his two new Secret Diary escapades, featuring top secret Tudor missions and intrigue and adventure from a Cornish coastal town. A great introduction to historical fiction and perfect for...
Description: Award-winning author Philip Ardagh combines fact and fiction in his two new Secret Diary escapades, featuring top secret Tudor missions and intrigue and adventure from a Cornish coastal town. A great introduction to historical fiction and perfect for fans of Horrible Histories, Philip's event shows you how he weaves hilarious historical facts with exciting plots.

Title: Mapping the Way Home with Livi Gosling
Teaser: Try your hand at the fascinating art of cartography with illustrator Livi Gosling. Her new book Maps of the United Kingdom is a beautiful, detailed atlas showing every county in Scotland, England, Wales and Northern Ireland, jammed with fun facts about...
Description: Try your hand at the fascinating art of cartography with illustrator Livi Gosling. Her new book Maps of the United Kingdom is a beautiful, detailed atlas showing every county in Scotland, England, Wales and Northern Ireland, jammed with fun facts about each spot. Come along to create your own personal UK map featuring stories of the places you've been or dream of visiting.

Title: Vivian French & Catherine Rayner: Saddle Up!
Teaser: If you're not horse-mad already, prepare to fall in love with the majestic creatures as highly acclaimed children's author Vivian French and illustrator Catherine Rayner share their beautiful, warm-hearted story, Hello, Horse. Providing a gentle...
Description: If you're not horse-mad already, prepare to fall in love with the majestic creatures as highly acclaimed children's author Vivian French and illustrator Catherine Rayner share their beautiful, warm-hearted story, Hello, Horse. Providing a gentle introduction to the animals for even the most unsure, they cover everything from understanding horse behaviour to safety tips, with lots of storytelling and live drawing thrown in.

Title: Intergalactic Adventures with Jen Campbell & Katie Harnett
Teaser: Strap on your space boots and prepare for an exciting Franklin and Luna adventure. This time, they're joined by their pet tortoise, Neil Armstrong! Contribute to the story and draw along as the creators of the bestselling Franklin's Flying Bookshop...
Description: Strap on your space boots and prepare for an exciting Franklin and Luna adventure. This time, they're joined by their pet tortoise, Neil Armstrong! Contribute to the story and draw along as the creators of the bestselling Franklin's Flying Bookshop present Franklin and Luna Go to the Moon. Let your love of reading send you soaring into the stratosphere.

Title: Michelle Robinson: The Pawed Piper
Teaser: The legend of The Pied Piper gets an adorably feline twist as one little girl plots to attract her own furry friend. Purr-fect for cat lovers and those dying for a pet of their own, come along to have a go at some creative, cat-inspired crafts as...
Description: The legend of The Pied Piper gets an adorably feline twist as one little girl plots to attract her own furry friend. Purr-fect for cat lovers and those dying for a pet of their own, come along to have a go at some creative, cat-inspired crafts as Michelle Robinson tells you about her story's inspiration and gives you a sneak peek into other upcoming tales.

Title: Bear's Big Band with David Litchfield
Teaser: Enter the jazz lounges of New Orleans with a cast of talented animal musicians in a tender, accessible story about jealousy. David Litchfield’s charming sequel to his award-winning The Bear and the Piano teaches us that good friends and good music are...
Description: Enter the jazz lounges of New Orleans with a cast of talented animal musicians in a tender, accessible story about jealousy. David Litchfield’s charming sequel to his award-winning The Bear and the Piano teaches us that good friends and good music are all you really need. With Bear on the piano and Hugo the dog learning the fiddle, there’s an instrument in the band for everyone – even you!

Title: Lights Out with Emily Haworth-Booth
Teaser: What would happen if a little boy who's afraid of the dark became king? In Emily Haworth-Booth's illuminating tale, we find out why a world kept awake in constant brightness is a lot scarier than the dark. See Emily bring her striking debut picture book...
Description: What would happen if a little boy who's afraid of the dark became king? In Emily Haworth-Booth's illuminating tale, we find out why a world kept awake in constant brightness is a lot scarier than the dark. See Emily bring her striking debut picture book to life with readings and drawing, teaching us how sometimes a little darkness can help us enjoy the light.

Title: Sylvia V Linsteadt: Enter the Wild Folk Wilderness
Teaser: Enter the magical world of Farallone, a place inspired by the plants and animals of author Sylvia V Linsteadt’s woodland home. The Wild Folk Rising, the latest tale in Sylvia’s Stargold Chronicles, is an epic fantasy quest rooted in folklore and...
Description: Enter the magical world of Farallone, a place inspired by the plants and animals of author Sylvia V Linsteadt’s woodland home. The Wild Folk Rising, the latest tale in Sylvia’s Stargold Chronicles, is an epic fantasy quest rooted in folklore and mythology. Sylvia discusses the important ecological ideas explored in her books as her characters try to save the land they love.

Title: Tracey Corderoy: One-Stop Story Shop
Teaser: Festival favourite Tracey Corderoy tells a story all about storytelling itself. Come along to take a thrilling trip from Starry Space to the Deep Dark Ocean as lost characters from different worlds visit the One-Stop Story Shop hoping to find a new...
Description: Festival favourite Tracey Corderoy tells a story all about storytelling itself. Come along to take a thrilling trip from Starry Space to the Deep Dark Ocean as lost characters from different worlds visit the One-Stop Story Shop hoping to find a new tale. Then, learn to draw your favourite characters in this lively, hands-on event.

Title: Unknown Underdogs with Martin Brown
Teaser: Iconic illustrator of the Horrible Histories series, Martin Brown sheds light on the hidden corners of the animal kingdom in Lesser Spotted Animals 2. With his signature stylised illustrations and irreverent humour, Martin teaches you about the...
Description: Iconic illustrator of the Horrible Histories series, Martin Brown sheds light on the hidden corners of the animal kingdom in Lesser Spotted Animals 2. With his signature stylised illustrations and irreverent humour, Martin teaches you about the brilliant beasts you never knew you never knew, from the altai argarli to the yellow-bellied glider. A quirky, fact-filled event for non-fiction fans.

Title: Retelling Roald Dahl's Matilda
Teaser: Selected as the 2019 Roald Dahl Book of the Year, Matilda is the magical and much-loved story of everyone’s favourite bookworm. Now it’s been added to the growing number of quality titles available in Scots. Join Scots writer and translator Anne...
Description: Selected as the 2019 Roald Dahl Book of the Year, Matilda is the magical and much-loved story of everyone’s favourite bookworm. Now it’s been added to the growing number of quality titles available in Scots. Join Scots writer and translator Anne Donovan as she provides an engaging introduction to the text for Scots speakers, language lovers and Roald Dahl fans everywhere.

Title: Hormone Diaries with Hannah Witton
Teaser: Influential vlogger Hannah Witton has written the book that 50% of the world has been waiting for. In The Hormone Diaries, she asks why nobody talks about periods. Using her experiences, and those of her 500,000 YouTube followers, she gives her honest,...
Description: Influential vlogger Hannah Witton has written the book that 50% of the world has been waiting for. In The Hormone Diaries, she asks why nobody talks about periods. Using her experiences, and those of her 500,000 YouTube followers, she gives her honest, humorous take on living with your period and explores the different cultural attitudes to them across the world. Expect a bloody fascinating and light-hearted event.

Title: Harriet Muncaster: Isadora Moon Returns
Teaser: Isadora Moon is proud to be different. With a fairy mum and a vampire dad, she combines magic and sparkle with a bit of bite! Harriet Muncaster introduces you to her totally unique heroine and otherworldly family as she presents the latest two tales in...
Description: Isadora Moon is proud to be different. With a fairy mum and a vampire dad, she combines magic and sparkle with a bit of bite! Harriet Muncaster introduces you to her totally unique heroine and otherworldly family as she presents the latest two tales in her bestselling series. Then, get creative with Harriet as she leads you through some dazzling drawing and captivating crafts.

Title: Unnerving Undead with M A Bennett & Gabriel Dylan
Teaser: Meet the authors of two spine-chilling psychological dramas. In Gabriel Dylan’s Whiteout, the local town on Charlie’s ski trip holds a sinister secret. In the thrilling sequel to M A Bennett’s S.T.A.G.S, a long-lost play has strange effects on the...
Description: Meet the authors of two spine-chilling psychological dramas. In Gabriel Dylan’s Whiteout, the local town on Charlie’s ski trip holds a sinister secret. In the thrilling sequel to M A Bennett’s S.T.A.G.S, a long-lost play has strange effects on the students rehearsing it. Discover the secrets to writing sophisticated suspense with two authors who have a knack for imagining what happens when the dead come back to life.

Title: Sibéal Pounder: Bad Mermaids and Witch Wars
Teaser: Think you know all there is to know about mermaids and witches? Wait until you meet bestselling World Book Day 2019 author Sibéal Pounder, creator of the Witch Wars and Bad Mermaids series. Find out the truth about your favourite fairy tales, and learn...
Description: Think you know all there is to know about mermaids and witches? Wait until you meet bestselling World Book Day 2019 author Sibéal Pounder, creator of the Witch Wars and Bad Mermaids series. Find out the truth about your favourite fairy tales, and learn how to create cool characters and build amazingly weird worlds. Broomsticks and shells strongly encouraged.

Title: Katherine Mengardon & Dominic Wilcox: Little Inventors
Teaser: Get ready to think big as Katherine Mengardon and Dominic Wilcox guide you through The Little Inventors Handbook, their step-by-step manual for coming up with ingenious inventions. Be inspired by scarf helicopters, toothbrush maracas and ladybird...
Description: Get ready to think big as Katherine Mengardon and Dominic Wilcox guide you through The Little Inventors Handbook, their step-by-step manual for coming up with ingenious inventions. Be inspired by scarf helicopters, toothbrush maracas and ladybird umbrellas to come up with some creative concepts of your own. Plus, learn some crazy facts about the history of inventions, science and design along the way.

Title: Become a Little Inventor
Teaser: Get your thinking cap on and drop in to design your own original invention with authors of The Little Inventors Handbook, Katherine Mengardon and Dominic Wilcox. With lots of different materials available, you can let your imagination roam free and...
Description: Get your thinking cap on and drop in to design your own original invention with authors of The Little Inventors Handbook, Katherine Mengardon and Dominic Wilcox. With lots of different materials available, you can let your imagination roam free and leave with your own invention prototype.

Title: Making Friends with Axel Scheffler
Teaser: Axel Scheffler has illustrated books for numerous authors including Julia Donaldson's The Gruffalo, but he also writes his own inventive stories. Little page-turners will love the delightful board book The New Friend, part of his bestselling Pip and...
Description: Axel Scheffler has illustrated books for numerous authors including Julia Donaldson's The Gruffalo, but he also writes his own inventive stories. Little page-turners will love the delightful board book The New Friend, part of his bestselling Pip and Posy series. This gentle, funny event has something to teach all ages about the power of friendship and kindness.

Title: Nessie Reimagined with Lari Don & Sara Sheridan
Teaser: What is the process of turning an idea into a book? How can the same idea appear as very different stories? Meet two Edinburgh authors, each putting their spin on the legend of the Loch Ness Monster. Lari Don’s The Treasure of the Loch Ness Monster...
Description: What is the process of turning an idea into a book? How can the same idea appear as very different stories? Meet two Edinburgh authors, each putting their spin on the legend of the Loch Ness Monster. Lari Don’s The Treasure of the Loch Ness Monster draws on local folklore, while Sara Sheridan’s Monsters Unite pulls Nessie into the 21st century in a brilliantly topical tale about pollution.

Title: Martin Figura presents Dr Zeeman’s Catastrophe Machine
Subtitle: The Formula for Love
Teaser: Is there a mathematical equation for love? What can be retrieved from life’s catastrophes and wounds? Martin Figura’s debut spoken word show Whistle was shortlisted for the Ted Hughes Award and received standing ovations all over the UK. Today he...
Description: Is there a mathematical equation for love? What can be retrieved from life’s catastrophes and wounds? Martin Figura’s debut spoken word show Whistle was shortlisted for the Ted Hughes Award and received standing ovations all over the UK. Today he presents Dr Zeeman's Catastrophe Machine, a follow-up which is no less breathtaking or life-affirming as it examines love through a scientific lens.

Title: Climb Aboard with Alexander McCall Smith & Iain McIntosh
Teaser: Set sail on the School Ship Tobermory with much-loved Edinburgh author Alexander McCall Smith and illustrator Iain McIntosh as they present the fourth title in their hugely successful series, The Secret of the Dark Waterfall. This time the gang are on...
Description: Set sail on the School Ship Tobermory with much-loved Edinburgh author Alexander McCall Smith and illustrator Iain McIntosh as they present the fourth title in their hugely successful series, The Secret of the Dark Waterfall. This time the gang are on the hunt for a shipwreck laden with treasure. You’ll need courage and ingenuity to help them find it.

Title: Open Book on A Passage to India
Subtitle: Reading Workshop
Teaser: Marjorie Lotfi Gill and Claire Urquhart from Open Book, a charity which organises shared reading groups, take an in-depth look at E M Forster's James Tait Black Memorial Prize-winning novel, A Passage to India. Published in 1924, the novel examines the...
Description: Marjorie Lotfi Gill and Claire Urquhart from Open Book, a charity which organises shared reading groups, take an in-depth look at E M Forster's James Tait Black Memorial Prize-winning novel, A Passage to India. Published in 1924, the novel examines the tensions and prejudices between Indians and the ruling British. Expect an open discussion from the start: read the book in advance or be inspired to pick it up afterwards.

Title: Daniel Gray on the Sports Journalism of Hugh McIlvanney
Subtitle: Reading Workshop
Teaser: Writer, presenter and researcher Daniel Gray is in love with the 'Beautiful Game', the subject of a number of his books. Join him to delve into the football writing of Scottish journalist Hugh McIlvanney, whose long career encompassed work for the...
Description: Writer, presenter and researcher Daniel Gray is in love with the 'Beautiful Game', the subject of a number of his books. Join him to delve into the football writing of Scottish journalist Hugh McIlvanney, whose long career encompassed work for the Scotsman, Sunday Times and Observer. McIlvanney was renowned for his perfectly crafted sentences: long, lyrical and rich with surprises. Read his work ahead of the event or be inspired to dip into it afterwards.

Title: M A Bennett on Lord of the Flies
Subtitle: Reading Workshop
Teaser: M A Bennett, author of thrilling novels for young adults, explores William Golding’s groundbreaking Lord of the Flies. Written in 1954, the novel centres on a group of boys stranded on an island. What begins as an adventure becomes a frightening...
Description: M A Bennett, author of thrilling novels for young adults, explores William Golding’s groundbreaking Lord of the Flies. Written in 1954, the novel centres on a group of boys stranded on an island. What begins as an adventure becomes a frightening example of how quickly the veneer of ‘civilisation’ can slip away. Expect an open discussion from the start; read the novel in advance or pick it up afterwards.

Title: Emiliano Monge on Dante's Inferno

A captivating discussion awaits.

Title: Masterclass: Writing Short Stories
